descriptions.en:
Catalyst Probes erupt from Lavos and douse combatants in a fiery gel. Damage is doubled for each element afflicting an enemy.

Hold to imbue the next ability cast with <DT_FIRE_COLOR>Heat.
descriptions.zh:
从无限术士体内迸发出催化探头，并把炽热的凝胶泼向对手。敌人身上每有一种元素异常状态，该技能的伤害便翻倍一次。

长按来为下一次的技能施放注入 <DT_FIRE_COLOR>火焰伤害。

descriptions.en:
Lash out with a toxic serpentine strike, consuming the target to heal Lavos.

Hold to imbue all abilities with <DT_POISON_COLOR>Toxin.
descriptions.zh:
施放一次毒蛇猛击，通过消耗目标的生命值来治疗无限术士。

长按来为所有技能注入<DT_POISON_COLOR>毒素伤害。

descriptions.en:
Launch a probe that converts Health and Energy Orbs into Universal Orbs that provide both, and ammo pickups into Universal Ammo Pickups. The probe shocks enemies in close proximity. Each electrocuted foe reduces other ability cooldowns by 1.5s.

Hold to imbue the next ability cast with <DT_ELECTRICITY_COLOR>Electricity.
descriptions.zh:
布下一枚探头，来把生命球和能量球转化为可提供这两种补给的通用补给球，也可把弹药拾取物转换为通用弹药拾取物。探头也会电击近距离的敌人。每击中一名敌人，其它技能的冷却时间减少 1.5 秒。

长按来为下一次的技能施放注入<DT_ELECTRICITY_COLOR>电击伤害。

descriptions.en:
Dash forward, crashing through enemies and leaving an icy trail of broken vials.

Hold to imbue the next ability cast with <DT_FREEZE_COLOR>Cold.
descriptions.zh:
前冲直撞穿过敌军，并留下破碎药瓶的冰迹。

长按来为下一次的技能施放注入<DT_FREEZE_COLOR>冰冻伤害。

descriptions.en: Launch a large particle of charged antimatter that will detonate on contact. Direct the particle by aiming, shoot it to charge it further. Deals <DT_EXPLOSION_COLOR>Blast Damage with a guaranteed Status Effect.
descriptions.zh: 发射一颗大型充能反物质粒子，触碰即引爆。通过瞄准来控制粒子方向，射击以进一步充能。造成 <DT_EXPLOSION_COLOR>爆炸伤害，并必定造成异常状态。

descriptions.en: Primes all enemies in an expanding radius with volatile antimatter. Press the ability to slow down enemy movement, hold the ability to speed them up.
descriptions.zh: 使用不稳定的反物质对一个不断扩大的范围内的所有敌人进行填充。按下技能键可减缓敌人移动速度，长按则加快其移动速度。

descriptions.en: Creates antimatter particles that orbit Nova and attack nearby targets. Each active particle reduces damage to Nova's Health and Shields.
descriptions.zh: 创造反物质粒子环绕超能新星四周，并自动攻击邻近目标。每个处于活动状态的粒子都会减少对超能新星的生命值和护盾造成的伤害。

descriptions.en: Creates a wormhole allowing instantaneous travel. Hold the ability to visualize placement.
descriptions.zh: 创造一个虫洞以实现瞬间移动。长按此技能可预览放置位置。

descriptions.en: Creates a localized storm of punishing explosions.
descriptions.zh: 在指定区域中制造出一阵局部轰炸风暴。

descriptions.en: Launches a plodding missile capable of unleashing a massive explosion.
descriptions.zh: 发射出一枚能造成大规模爆炸的慢速导弹。

descriptions.en: The Itzal Archwing teleports a short distance, dropping all enemy target locks.
descriptions.zh: 刺影曲翼瞬移一小段距离，尽数甩开锁定了目标的敌人。

descriptions.en: Activates a cloaking field that hides the Warframe and any nearby allies who remain stationary.
descriptions.zh: 展开一道隐形力场，使静止于力场中的战甲与友军隐匿行踪。

descriptions.en: Deploys drones that fight alongside the Warframe, each detonating in a destructive blast when killed.
descriptions.zh: 部署数台无人战机于战甲身旁进行战斗，当无人战机被破坏时会造成毁灭性的爆炸。

descriptions.en: The Warframe emits a massive pulse of energy, stunning nearby enemies and sending them flying.
descriptions.zh: 战甲放出巨大的能量脉冲，晕眩并击飞附近的敌人。

descriptions.en: Vents out the Archwing's propulsion core, confusing enemy projectiles and causing them to detonate.
descriptions.zh: 将曲翼推进器核心中的气体排出，混淆并使敌方导弹引爆。

descriptions.en: Forms a protective energy shell around the Warframe
descriptions.zh: 形成一个围绕并保护着战甲的能量护罩。

descriptions.en: Drops flare beacons confusing incoming guided missiles.
descriptions.zh: 放出可以混淆敌方导弹接近的热诱弹。

descriptions.en: Launch a tethered hook that either pulls enemies close, or pulls the Warframe toward any stationary objects it hooks onto.
descriptions.zh: 发射一道钩索把敌人拉近，或是把战甲拉向被其钩住的任何一个静止物体。

descriptions.en: Forms a miniature black hole that sucks in all nearby objects before rupturing in a massive shock wave.
descriptions.zh: 形成一个会吸进附近所有物体的微型黑洞，并在最后爆裂造成大规模的冲击震波。

descriptions.en: Fires a large volley of homing missiles.
descriptions.zh: 连续发射大量导弹。

descriptions.en: Creates beacons that draw enemy fire, converting the damage into healing pulses.
descriptions.zh: 制造信标来吸引敌人的火力，将伤害转换为治疗的脉冲。

descriptions.en: Tiny drones orbit the Warframe or an ally, and intercept enemy fire.
descriptions.zh: 释放小型无人机围绕着战甲或队友并拦截敌人的火力。

descriptions.en: All damage taken is transformed into Energy, while abilities gain enhanced Range, Duration and Power. Affects the Warframe and nearby allies.
descriptions.zh: 将所有受到的伤害会转换成能量，同时技能会得到范围，持续时间和强度上的提升。这个效果会影响战甲和附近的队友。

descriptions.en: Renders the Warframe and nearby allies immune to Status Effects, while slowing nearby enemies.
descriptions.zh: 使得 战甲和附近的队友免疫异常状态，同时减缓附近敌人的速度。

descriptions.en: Fires a high-yield, remotely detonated explosive projectile capable of latching onto targets.
descriptions.zh: 发射出一枚可附着在目标上并遥控引爆的高效爆裂物。

descriptions.en: Banshee emits a sonic shockwave that pushes targets in range with enough force to incapacitate or kill attackers.
descriptions.zh: 恸哭女妖释放一道音波冲击波，将范围内的敌人击退，使其失去战斗力并降低他们的护甲。

descriptions.en: Using Silence surrounds Banshee in an aura that stuns enemies and will limit their perceptions and tactical response to gunfire and Warframe attacks.
descriptions.zh: 使用静音会使恸哭女妖笼罩在一层光环之中，该光环会眩晕敌人，限制其对枪声和战甲攻击的感知及战术反应，并使他们无法激活自身的技能。

descriptions.en: Using acoustic location, Banshee's Sonar power finds and tracks enemies, and exposes critical weak spots to everyone in your squad.
descriptions.zh: 恸哭女妖的声纳技能可以利用声波进行定位，借以侦测及追踪敌人，并使队伍成员发觉敌人身上暴露出的致命弱点。

descriptions.en: Channeling all of her acoustic energy into the environment, Banshee uses ultrasonic reverberations to violently shake the ground.
descriptions.zh: 恸哭女妖将她所有的声音能量传导至周遭环境，使用超声波反响剧烈撼动目标区域的地面。

descriptions.en: Draws power from the decibel level of sound in the area and uses it to amplify a damage buff for Octavia and her allies. It also doubles the damage and range of nearby Mallets.
descriptions.zh: 从环境的分贝水平中获取能量，用来扩大吟游歌者和友军的伤害增幅。同时将附近槌音铮鏦的伤害和范围加倍。

descriptions.en: Launches a rollerball that charms foes to follow it. Combines with the Mallet to create a roving ball of sonic destruction.
descriptions.zh: 发射一枚滚球，利用音乐的渲染力令敌人跟随它。与槌音铮鏦相结合便可创造出一个徘徊移动的音波破坏球。

descriptions.en: Grants buffs to those who consistently perform actions in time to Octavia's music. Timed jumps offer the Vivace speed buff. Crouching on the beat grants cloaking with the Nocturne buff. Firing rhythmically bestows Opera multishot buff. Timed melee swings give the Forte damage buff.
descriptions.zh: 给予随着吟游歌者的音乐做出相应动作的人各类增益效果。合拍的跳跃提供轻挑快板速度加成。跟上节拍的下蹲给予夜曲的隐匿增益。有节奏地射击可获得歌剧戏曲的多重射击加成。合拍的近战攻击给以强音奏鸣曲伤害加成。

descriptions.en: Rhythmically beats damage into nearby enemies and draws their fire. Damage inflicted on the Mallet increases its lethality.
descriptions.zh: 随着节奏对附近的敌人造成伤害，并吸引他们的火力。施加在槌音铮鏦上的伤害会增加其杀伤力。

descriptions.en: Valkyr lets out a rallying cry that bolsters Armor and Attack Speed for allies while in <AFFINITY_SHARE>Affinity Range.
descriptions.zh: 瓦尔基里发出激励式咆哮， 为 <AFFINITY_SHARE>经验共享范围内的友军增强护甲和攻击速度。

descriptions.en: Valkyr hurls forth a hook and pulls herself to whatever it hits. If it hits an enemy, nearby foes are pulled in as she unleashes a coordinated Melee attack.
descriptions.zh: 瓦尔基里发射钩索，将自己拉向命中的目标点。如果钩索命中敌人，则附近的敌人也会被拉向目标点，同时瓦尔基里会发动一次连携近战攻击。

descriptions.en: Valkyr bares her deadly claws, unleashing devastating attacks that also heal her. Valkyr becomes immune to Status Effects and her Armor bonus from Warcry is multiplied while using the claws.
descriptions.zh: 瓦尔基里露出致命的利爪，释放毁灭性攻击的同时治疗自身。瓦尔基里在使用利爪时免疫异常状态，且通过咆哮获得的护甲翻倍。

descriptions.en: Unleash a damaging blast, slowing its victims while increasing their Melee Damage Vulnerability.
descriptions.zh: 释放一道破坏性的冲击波使敌人减速，并使其受到的近战伤害增加。

descriptions.en: Summon a Bulwark rock-wall, activate again to send the rocks crashing toward the enemy. Bulwarks attacked by enemies release an area-of-effect Slash powered by the Health it has lost.
descriptions.zh: 召唤一堵「大地堡垒」石墙，再次启用技能可使巨石滚动压倒前方的敌人。被敌人攻击的石墙会释放一个区域性的切割伤害，由其失去的生命值来维持。

descriptions.en: Atlas' hardened gaze will fossilize foes increasing the damage they take, heal Rumblers, and create Petrified Bulwarks. When shattered, petrified enemies drop healing Rubble for Atlas.
descriptions.zh: 撼天刑者强硬的凝视将石化敌人、治疗石头人，并创造出石化壁垒。当石化的敌人碎裂后，将掉出可以治疗撼天刑者的碎石。

descriptions.en: Bash enemies with an explosive sliding punch, repeat up to three times for a combo attack. Each hit in the three-punch combo increases the radius of the attack. Energy cost is reduced with each hit of Landslide. Install mods on the Landslide Fists to boost stats.
descriptions.zh: 用爆炸性的滑行冲拳猛击敌人，最多重复三次，形成连击。三拳连击中的每一后续攻击都会增加攻击范围。土石坍方的每次命中都会减少能量消耗。可通过在土石坍方上装备振幅晶体增加属性数值。

descriptions.en: Summon two elemental stone brawlers to the melee. Summoning petrifies enemies in close proximity to Atlas. When finished, Rumblers collapse into a pile of healing Rubble.
descriptions.zh: 召唤两个元素石头近战打手。召唤动作将石化临近撼天刑者的敌人。当它们的生命结束时，石头人将碎成一堆用于治疗的碎石。

descriptions.en: Temporarily shed the outer pieces of Xaku in a destructive blast, then stalk the battlefield in a new, swifter skeletal form. Enemies damaged by the body shrapnel are rendered weaker to <DT_RADIANT_COLOR>Void Damage. Xaku's other active abilities' duration is frozen in time and resumes once The Vast Untime expires.
descriptions.zh: 虚空残响的外层结构在毁灭性的爆炸中暂时舍弃，然后以全新的骨骼形态疾步潜行于战场。受到虚空残响身体碎片击中的敌人会更难抵御 <DT_RADIANT_COLOR>虚空伤害。在超维炼狱施放期间，虚空残响其他主动技能的持续时间将会冻结，技能终止时恢复。

descriptions.en: Cycle through a trio of lost Warframe powers. Accuse manifests a Void fissure to corrupt enemies into allies. Gaze grasps targets in Void tendrils that capture damage and inflict it when the target is released. Deny annihilates with a beam of Void energy, wiping Sentient resistances.
descriptions.zh: 循环切换三种失落之技。「指责」幻化出虚空裂缝，来让敌人堕落成为友军。「凝视」通过虚空卷须抓住目标，并在目标被释放时，捕捉伤害并对目标造成伤害。「否认」通过一束虚空能量来进行湮灭攻击，并消除灵煞抗性。

descriptions.en: Void Tendrils steal weapons from nearby enemies to use as your own floating, auto-targeting armament. Damage output increases based on enemy level. The number of weapons grabbed also determines the damage multiplier for The Lost: Deny's Void beam.
descriptions.zh: 虚空卷须偷取附近敌人的武器，以作为自己的浮空自瞄武器来使用。伤害输出会根据敌人等级增加。抢到的武器数量也决定了「失落之技：否认」的虚空射线的伤害倍数。

descriptions.en: Wield <DT_RADIANT_COLOR>Void Damage for all attacks from equipped weapons when activated.
descriptions.zh: 技能激活期间，所有装备的武器都会造成 <DT_RADIANT_COLOR>虚空伤害。

descriptions.en: Cycle through three songs that strengthen allies. Power of The Seven increases Ability Strength. Deathbringer increases Weapon Damage. Spirit of Resilience increases Shield Effectiveness. Extend the duration of each song by killing enemies surrounded by Judgments.
descriptions.zh: 循环奏响三首颂歌增强友军。《七人众之力》增加技能强度。《死亡使者》增加武器伤害。《坚韧之灵》增加护盾效率。消灭被审判的敌人可以延长颂歌的持续时间。

descriptions.en: Soar with destructive power. Use alternate-fire to detonate Judgments, causing an explosion of Jade Light. Enemies inside the Light's Judgment radius empower the explosion.
descriptions.zh: 以毁灭性的力量翱翔天际。使用次要射击模式引爆审判，造成翠玉之光爆炸。处于圣光审判影响范围内的敌人会增强爆炸效果。

descriptions.en: Jade summons an accusatory gaze that slows nearby enemies and dissolves their Shields and Armor. When the gaze falls upon allies, they can be revived from a distance.
descriptions.zh: 圣天使召唤谴责之瞳使附近的敌人减速并分解他们的护盾和护甲。当谴责之瞳凝视友军时，可以将其远距离复活。

descriptions.en: Create a well of light that heals allies and hurts enemies. Those who enter the well will be highlighted by Judgments.
descriptions.zh: 创造一口圣光之井治愈友军并对敌人造成伤害。进入井中的敌人将被"审判"标记。

descriptions.en: Guard yourself and nearby allies against Status Effects. Each time Qorvex kills or assists in killing an enemy affected by <DT_RADIATION_COLOR>Radiation Status, the number of Status Effects Disometric Guard can prevent increases.
descriptions.zh: 保护自己和附近的友军免受异常状态影响。辐能堡垒每次消灭或协助消灭受到 <DT_RADIATION_COLOR>辐射状态影响的敌人时，辐量防护可以阻止的异常状态数量会增加。

descriptions.en: Release a beam from Qorvex's Crucible Core. Each enemy struck suffers <DT_RADIATION_COLOR>Radiation Damage with a guaranteed Status Effect. Enemies affected by <DT_RADIATION_COLOR>Radiation Status explode in a chain reaction.
descriptions.zh: 从辐能堡垒的堆芯中释放光束。对命中的所有敌人造成 <DT_RADIATION_COLOR>辐射伤害，且必定触发异常状态。命中受到 <DT_RADIATION_COLOR>辐射异常状态影响的敌人会引发链式反应爆炸。

descriptions.en: Summon a Chyrinka Pillar that slows enemies. It pulses <DT_RADIATION_COLOR>Radiation Damage with a guaranteed Status Effect.
descriptions.zh: 召唤出一根辐射柱体来减速敌人。它会造成 <DT_RADIATION_COLOR>辐射伤害且必定触发异常状态。

descriptions.en: Contain the threat. Qorvex summons walls that slam together, damaging all enemies caught between them and inflicting <DT_RADIATION_COLOR>Radiation Status.
descriptions.zh: 遏制威胁。辐能堡垒召唤出墙壁并使其猛烈撞击在一起，对夹在其中的所有敌人造成伤害并造成 <DT_RADIATION_COLOR>辐射异常状态。

descriptions.en: When activated, this power stores damage caused by guns. When triggered again, that damage is channelled through the next gunshot.
descriptions.zh: 启动时，这个技能会储存枪支造成的伤害。当再次启动，储存的伤害会导引至下一次射击。

descriptions.en: With intense focus, Mesa draws her Regulator pistols, shooting down her foes in rapid succession.
descriptions.zh: 在极度的专注之下，圣枪弥撒抽出监察者双枪，对敌人快速地连续射击。

descriptions.en: Envelops Mesa in a barrier of energy, reflecting back incoming bullet damage.
descriptions.zh: 圣枪弥撒笼罩在能量障壁之中，反射来袭的子弹伤害。

descriptions.en: Gives an ally Extra Damage while jamming the guns of nearby enemies. This power shifts between team members.
descriptions.zh: 为队友增加额外伤害，同时干扰附近敌人的枪支运作。这个能力会在队伍成员之间转移。

descriptions.en: Supercharge Dagath's weapons with extra Critical Damage. The effects are doubled on Doomed enemies. Escape fatal blows by briefly assuming a spectral form.
descriptions.zh: 为无面骑影的武器提供额外的暴击伤害。对被厄运诅咒的敌人效果加倍。遭受致命攻击时短暂地进入幽灵形态并逃脱。

descriptions.en: Condemn nearby enemies to their doom. A portion of the damage Dagath deals is revisited upon them by a Wyrd Scythe. They also suffer <DT_VIRAL_COLOR>Viral Damage.
descriptions.zh: 用厄运诅咒附近的敌人。无面骑影对敌人造成的部分伤害会通过命定镰刃再次施加。敌人还会受到 <DT_VIRAL_COLOR>病毒伤害。

descriptions.en: Phantom Kaithes charge forth, inflicting <DT_VIRAL_COLOR>Viral Damage upon all in their path. Their attack strips the defenses of Doomed enemies.
descriptions.zh: 召唤绝灵骥幻影向前冲锋，对其冲锋路径上的所有人造成 <DT_VIRAL_COLOR>病毒伤害。同时削弱被厄运诅咒敌人的防御。

descriptions.en: Wyrd Scythes surround Dagath and seek out nearby enemies. Those struck are slowed and suffer <DT_VIRAL_COLOR>Viral Damage with a guaranteed Status Effect. The scythes also spread Doom and extend its duration.
descriptions.zh: 命定镰刃包围无面骑影并寻找附近的敌人。被击中的敌人会被减速并受到 <DT_VIRAL_COLOR>病毒伤害且必定触发异常状态。镰刃还会传播厄运并延长其持续时间。

descriptions.en: Uriel and his demons create a growing ring of flaming brimstone. Charge the ability by utilizing demon abilities. Damage inflicted increases with each consecutive hit.
descriptions.zh: 炼狱使徒和他的恶魔们创造出一个不断扩大的炽热硫磺圈。使用恶魔技能可以为此技能充能。每次连续命中都会增加造成的伤害。

descriptions.en: Uriel rips out the souls of his demons, draining their health, and sends them in search of new victims. Souls explode on contact with an enemy, rendering it vulnerable to Damage.
descriptions.zh: 炼狱使徒取出他恶魔的灵魂，吸取他们的生命，然后驱使他们去寻找新的受害者。这些灵魂在接触敌人时会爆炸，使敌人容易受到伤害。

descriptions.en:
Manifest an aura of flames inflicting <DT_FIRE_COLOR>Heat Damage and Status Effect on nearby enemies.

Tap Dodge while airborne to take flight as a flaming meteor of destruction.
descriptions.zh:
释放火焰光环，对附近敌人造成 <DT_FIRE_COLOR>火焰伤害和异常状态。

在空中按下闪避即可化身为毁灭性的火焰流星飞行。

descriptions.en: Uriel heals himself and his demons. If his demons are dead, they are resurrected.
descriptions.zh: 炼狱使徒治愈自己和他的恶魔。如果他的恶魔死去，他们将被复活。

descriptions.en: Uriel rips out the souls of his demons, draining their health, and sends them in search of new victims. Souls explode on contact with an enemy, rendering it vulnerable to Damage.
descriptions.zh: 炼狱使徒取出他恶魔的灵魂，吸取他们的生命，然后驱使他们去寻找新的受害者。这些灵魂在接触敌人时会爆炸，使敌人容易受到伤害。

descriptions.en: Grendel curls into a ball. He heals over time as he rolls, knocking over anyone in his path. Jumping slams Grendel into the ground and generates a damaging shockwave.
descriptions.zh: 暴食者蜷缩成一个球，在此期间他会随时间流逝恢复生命值，并冲撞任何胆敢挡住他的人。跳跃会让暴食者朝地面猛砸，并产生一股破坏性的冲击波。

descriptions.en: Regenerate health as Grendel absorbs nourishment from enemies in his gut. While he digests, enemies that attack or are attacked by Grendel suffer <DT_VIRAL_COLOR>Viral Damage and energy sources provide more energy. These buffs extend to squad mates.
descriptions.zh: 暴食者从他腹内的敌人摄取营养并恢复生命值。当他消化时，攻击暴食者或被暴食者攻击的敌人遭受<DT_VIRAL_COLOR>病毒伤害，并且能量源提供更多的能量。小队队员也会获得这些增益。

descriptions.en: Swallow enemies whole and store them in Grendel's gut. Hold to vomit out stored enemies, covering them in toxic bile.
descriptions.zh: 将敌人囫囵吞入暴食者的腹内。按住技能键即可将腹内的敌人吐出，而这些敌人身上会覆盖着毒性消化液。

descriptions.en: Violently puke out a bile soaked enemy from Grendel's gut, turning the consumed into a toxic projectile. Nearby enemies are slowed and have their armor dissolved by the bile.
descriptions.zh: 将浸泡在暴食者体内消化液里的一个敌人猛烈吐出，让这个被吞噬的生物成为一团毒素投射物，并基于敌人的最大生命值造成额外伤害。其消化液会使附近的敌人减速，并且会溶解他们的护甲。

descriptions.en: Exhale a deep breath of elemental destruction. Tap to cycle through elements, hold to cast. The chosen element applies to all of Chroma's abilities.
descriptions.zh: 释放一股毁灭性的元素吐息。轻点技能键来在各个元素之间进行切换，按住技能键来施放技能。选中的元素会应用于怒炎龙骑所有的技能。

descriptions.en: Depending on Chroma's elemental alignment, an offensive area-of-effect is created. Chroma and its nearby allies are imbued with defensive energy.
descriptions.zh: 根据怒炎龙骑的元素属性，制造攻击性的范围效果。而怒炎龙骑和附近的盟友会被这股防御能量保护。

descriptions.en: Chroma turns his pelt into a massive sentry that strengthens nearby allies and engulfs enemies in elemental attacks.
descriptions.zh: 怒炎龙骑把他的皮甲转换成一个巨大的警戒护卫，它可以增强附近的盟友并且用元素属性攻击吞噬敌人。

descriptions.en: Chroma fortifies squad Armor when his Shields are damaged or he kills an enemy with a melee weapon. He increases squad Weapon Damage when he loses Health or he kills an enemy with a ranged weapon, double the effect on weak point kills.
descriptions.zh: 怒炎龙骑的护盾受损或使用近战武器消灭敌人时会强化小队的护甲。当他损失生命值或使用远程武器杀死敌人时，会增加小队的武器伤害，以弱点消灭则效果加倍。
需要满冰能量才能施放。先祖之灵降临在舞霜剑姬身上，她随即开始剑舞，对周围敌人造成持续伤害。对标记目标按下攻击键，即可发射粉碎性的冰刃斩击，削弱其护甲和护盾。击中被冻结的敌人会使其爆炸，造成大范围 <DT_FREEZE_COLOR>冰冻伤害。

轻按可跃向空中，再次轻按即可落在目标位置。落地时，对大范围内的敌人施加 <DT_FREEZE_COLOR>冰冻伤害易伤和异常状态效果。

每击中一个敌人可获得冰能量。

通过吸收附近敌人施加的 <DT_FREEZE_COLOR>冰冻异常状态来恢复护盾。如果护盾已满，则获得 <OVERGUARD_GAIN>超宏防护。

每击中一个敌人可获得冰能量。

挥舞舞霜剑姬的细剑寒霜疾剑进行突刺，对正前方敌人造成 <DT_FREEZE_COLOR>冰冻伤害以及 <DT_FREEZE_COLOR>冰冻和 <DT_PUNCTURE_COLOR>穿刺异常状态。

每击中一个敌人可获得冰能量。

descriptions.en: Protect Ember with flame armor that burns stronger over time, consuming energy once its meter is at full strength. Cast again to extinguish the flame.
descriptions.zh: 通过火焰装甲来保护永恒烈焰，随时间的推移保护效果会增强。计量表达到最大度数后会消耗能量。重新施放技能可以熄灭火焰。

descriptions.en: Command a flaming comet to crash down in front of Ember, engulfing enemies with a fire that can spread through their ranks.
descriptions.zh: 召唤一颗燃烧的彗星坠落在永恒烈焰的前面，让不断扩散的火焰吞没敌人。

descriptions.en: Release a fiery projectile that ignites enemies on contact.
descriptions.zh: 释放一个燃烧的投射物，点燃接触到的目标。

descriptions.en: Slam the ground to create a wave of incinerating plasma that knocks back enemies and strips their armor.
descriptions.zh: 猛击地面以产生一道焚化的等离子波来将敌人击退并剥去他们的护甲。

descriptions.en: Skewer and hold a target, siphoning their health. Use again to hurl the victim damaging them and anyone near the impact site.
descriptions.zh: 刺穿并抓住一个目标来吸取他们的生命值。再次使用该技能来把受害者用力掷出，以对他们和撞击点附近的任何人造成伤害。

descriptions.en: Launch a pattern of charged mines all around you. Each mine detonates in a violent blast when touched, damaging enemies in a three-meter radius.
descriptions.zh: 在周围布下一圈带电地雷。每个地雷在被碰触时都会产生剧烈爆炸，并对周围半径 3 米内的敌人产生伤害。

descriptions.en: Hurl a canister of graviton fluids to create a wide mire that will significantly slow enemies traveling across it. Alternatively, the canister can be shot in mid-air to create a fiery conflagration.
descriptions.zh: 抛出一罐引力液体来制造一片宽阔的泥沼，在泥沼上行进的敌人会大大减速。此外，也可以将罐子射向半空来制造烈焰。

descriptions.en: Sweep surrounding enemies into the line of fire and suspend them in air with a force beam.
descriptions.zh: 通过一道强力光束将周围的敌人扫入火线并将他们悬空。

descriptions.en: Raise Bonewidow's shield to block incoming forward damage, reflecting it back at attackers. While active, bash enemies with a Maiden's Kiss.
descriptions.zh: 举起骨骸寡妇的盾牌，以阻挡前方来袭的伤害，并将该伤害反弹给攻击者。在技能激活时，通过「室女之吻」来打击敌人。

descriptions.en: Swathe the Necramech in a powerful electrical field that greatly enhances survivability in close combat. Enemies that strike the shroud will suffer for their impudence.
descriptions.zh: 将殁世机甲笼罩在一道强力电场中，以大幅提升近战时的生存能力。击中这一电场罩的敌人会为他们的无礼付出代价。

descriptions.en: Summon a devastating exalted blade.
descriptions.zh: 召唤毁天灭地的显赫武器。

descriptions.en: Take a stationary stance to deploy maximum firepower and gain increased structural integrity for a time.
descriptions.zh: 采取静止姿态来部署最大火力，并在一段时间内获得结构完整性的提升。

descriptions.en: Emit a bright flash of light, blinding all nearby enemies.
descriptions.zh: 释放一道明亮的闪光，致盲附近所有的敌人。

descriptions.en: Radial javelins impale nearby enemies, inflicting <DT_SLASH_COLOR>Slash Status.
descriptions.zh: 发射广域标枪刺穿附近的敌人，造成 <DT_SLASH_COLOR>切割异常状态。

descriptions.en: Slash and dash through enemies alongside a radial specter. The powerful Exalted Blade’s slashes inflict <DT_SLASH_COLOR>Slash Status.
descriptions.zh: 随着残影对敌人进行冲刺斩击。强大的显赫刀剑斩击造成 <DT_SLASH_COLOR>切割异常状态。

descriptions.en: Summon a sword of pure light and immense power.
descriptions.zh: 召唤一把充斥着纯洁光亮和无限力量的剑。

descriptions.en: Radial javelins impale nearby enemies, inflicting <DT_SLASH_COLOR>Slash Status.
descriptions.zh: 发射广域标枪刺穿附近的敌人，造成 <DT_SLASH_COLOR>切割异常状态。

descriptions.en: Let out ferocious howl that stuns nearby enemies and causes Sentients to shed any built up resistances.
descriptions.zh: 用凶猛的嚎声震慑附近的敌人，并消除灵煞敌人所积累的全部抗性。

descriptions.en: Slash and dash through enemies alongside a radial specter. The powerful Exalted Blade’s slashes inflict <DT_SLASH_COLOR>Slash Status.
descriptions.zh: 随着残影对敌人进行冲刺斩击。强大的显赫刀剑斩击造成 <DT_SLASH_COLOR>切割异常状态。

descriptions.en: Summon a sword of pure light and immense power.
descriptions.zh: 召唤一把充斥着纯洁光亮和无限力量的剑。

descriptions.en: Enemies fumble their weapons as they are whisked into the air. Nearby allies become immune to Status Effects. Hold the ability to cast the immunity onto Titania.
descriptions.zh: 把敌人扫到空中，使其丢掉武器；让附近的友军对异常状态免疫。长按此技能来使幻蝶仙灵获得免疫效果。

descriptions.en: Shrink down and take flight, while razorflies attack nearby enemies and amplify the damage they take.
descriptions.zh: 缩小身体并进入飞行状态，同时剃刀蝶会攻击附近的敌人并放大他们所受到的伤害。

descriptions.en: Create a swarm of razorflies that transform an enemy into an irresistible floating beacon, attracting witless comrades before exploding on command.
descriptions.zh: 制造一群剃刀蝶将敌人转换为一个具有强力吸引力的漂浮信标，在爆炸以前吸引那些不明事理的战友靠近。

descriptions.en: Cycle through and extract one of the four Buffs when cast on an enemy. Thorns reduces incoming damage. Dust degrades enemy accuracy. Full Moon increases companion damage. Entangle slows enemies within range.
descriptions.zh: 当对一名敌人施放技能时，循环切换并从四种增益效果中选取出一种。「荆棘」减免来袭的伤害。「尘埃」降低敌人的精准度。「满月」增加同伴的伤害。「纠缠」使范围内的敌人减速。

descriptions.en: Summons a treacherous landslide of ice that instantly freezes and shatters all enemies in its radius.
descriptions.zh: 唤来变化莫测的雪崩，瞬间冻结并粉碎范围内的所有敌人。

descriptions.en: Frost deep freezes any vapor and moisture in the area, creating a protective sphere with brief invulnerability to boost its strength.
descriptions.zh: 冻结周围所有水气与水分，制造出能用来防御的球形冰罩；冰罩生成时有短暂的无敌时间，此时敌人对冰罩造成的伤害能强化冰罩的耐久度；在相同位置重复施放冰罩可强化其耐久度。

descriptions.en: Sends a wave of razor sharp, crystalized ice toward an enemy, dealing heavy damage.
descriptions.zh: 制造一道由锋利冰晶构成的冰浪来对敌人造成大量伤害及缓速效果。

descriptions.en: A frigid energy blast that freezes targets in their tracks.
descriptions.zh: 发射一道极度低温的能量来冻结目标。

descriptions.en:
Throw two Elemental Ammo Packs that instantly refill the active weapon’s magazine, while granting the weapon an additional instance of the selected Elemental Damage and Status Effect. Reload clears the effect. Sniper Rifles gain extra damage.

Hold the ability to select the Elemental Damage type.
descriptions.zh:
投掷两个元素弹药包，可立即为当前的武器填满弹匣，同时为武器附加所选的元素伤害和异常状态。重新装填会清除效果。狙击枪可获得额外伤害。

长按技能键以选择元素伤害类型。

descriptions.en: Jump backwards and become invisible for a short duration. Killing enemies on their Weak Points extends the duration and heals Cyte-09.
descriptions.zh: 向后跳跃并短暂隐形。弱点击杀可延长持续时间并治疗九。

descriptions.en: Plant an antenna that projects a forward wave scan. Detected enemies take increased Weak Point Damage, and become visible through walls. Weapons gain Punch through.
descriptions.zh: 放置一根天线向前发射扫描波。被探测到的敌人会受到更高的弱点伤害，并可透过墙壁被看到。武器获得穿透。

descriptions.en: Summon the Neutralizer, Cyte-09’s exalted Sniper Rifle. Bullets ricochet off Weak Points to seek out other nearby Weak Points. Alt fire lobs a <DT_FREEZE_COLOR>Cold grenade that completely freezes enemies.
descriptions.zh: 召唤肃清者，九的显赫狙击步枪。命中弱点的子弹会弹射追踪附近的其它弱点。次要射击发射 <DT_FREEZE_COLOR>冰冻榴弹，完全冻结敌人。

descriptions.en: Garuda sacrifices her health to generate energy and clear Status Effects.
descriptions.zh: 迦楼罗以她的生命值为代价换取能量并清除异常状态。

descriptions.en: Rip the life force from an enemy and use it as a shield that captures damage, this kills significantly weakened enemies instantly. Charge to channel the captured damage into an explosive projectile.
descriptions.zh: 从敌人身上割取生命之力以作为抵挡伤害的盾。蓄力可使抵挡的伤害化为爆裂破片。

descriptions.en: Impale an enemy on an altar of talons and siphon health for Garuda and her allies.
descriptions.zh: 以利爪构筑的祭坛刺穿敌人，为自己及队友吸取生命。

descriptions.en: Charge to expand the targeting area, release to send Garuda's talons careening toward each target in area. Surviving enemies are prone to <DT_SLASH_COLOR>Slash Status.
descriptions.zh: 蓄力可扩大瞄准区域，接着对瞄准区域里的每一名敌人发射高速利爪；幸存的敌人极有可能受 <DT_SLASH_COLOR>切割异常状态影响。

descriptions.en: Deploy a gem that shoots prismatic beams. The gem targets enemies that are taking weapon damage from Citrine and her allies. Its beams inflict Heat, Cold, Toxin, and Electricity Status Effects. Status Chance and Status Duration increase for nearby allies.
descriptions.zh: 放置一颗发射棱彩光束的宝石。宝石瞄准正受到辉光晶灵和其队友武器伤害的敌人。其光束造成火焰、冰冻、毒素和电击异常状态。附近队友的触发几率和触发时间增加。

descriptions.en: Citrine summons crystal fractals. The fractals rush forward, seeking enemies. Enemies touched by the fractals are paralyzed by crystalline growths. Hit the growths to deal Critical Damage.
descriptions.zh: 辉光晶灵召唤水晶分形。分形向前冲，寻找敌人。被分形触碰的敌人会因水晶生长而瘫痪。击中水晶生长以造成暴击伤害。

descriptions.en: Slash and stagger enemies with a crystal blast that inflicts <DT_SLASH_COLOR>Slash Status. Enemies afflicted with this Status Effect have an increased chance of dropping Health and Energy Orbs.
descriptions.zh: 用造成 <DT_SLASH_COLOR>切割异常状态的水晶爆裂切割敌人并使敌人失衡。在此异常状态下的敌人有更高的几率掉落生命球和能量球。

descriptions.en: Citrine guards herself and nearby allies with a crystalline shell that gradually decays. Kills and assists increase the defensive power of the shell.
descriptions.zh: 辉光晶灵通过逐渐衰减的水晶外壳保护自己和附近的盟友。消灭和助攻可以增加外壳的防御能力。

descriptions.en: Trap enemies in a carousel of mirrors, forcing them to attack visions of their true selves. Destroyed mirrors damage their attackers, as does the collapse of the carousel.
descriptions.zh: 制造一圈旋转的镜面吸引敌人，迫使他们攻击自己的镜像。镜面遭到破坏时将会伤害攻击者；当复数镜面瓦解时将对范围内所有敌人造成伤害。

descriptions.en: Create an expanding ring of molten glass that slowly crystallizes enemies who enter. When the expansion is complete, the ring hardens to block weapons fire. The ring draws extra strength from the health and shields of crystallized enemies. Use Shattered Lash to smash the ring and send razor-sharp glass flying.
descriptions.zh: 创造一圈逐渐扩张的熔融玻璃环，进入环内的敌人将逐渐结晶化。当扩张完毕时，玻璃环将硬化并能阻挡外界火力。环可以从结晶化敌人的护盾和生命中获取额外的力量。使用「琉璃碎击」可以击碎玻璃环，并将尖锐的玻璃碎片击飞。

descriptions.en: Lash out with stream of shattered glass, or hold for an arcing strike. Stats are boosted by the equipped mods on Shattered Lash.
descriptions.zh: 使用一束玻璃碎片向前方猛击，按住技能键则可改变攻击轨迹，依弧线挥出玻璃束。装备在「琉璃碎击」的振幅晶体可以增强技能威力。

descriptions.en: Gara's armor splinters into a maelstrom of shattered glass. Allies who contact the cloud are fortified against damage.
descriptions.zh: 琉璃仕女的护甲会分裂为碎玻璃组成的漩涡。置身其中的友军可减免敌人的伤害。

descriptions.en: Gain a brief burst of increased Critical Chance and Energy Regen, with each kill extending duration of Cathode Grace. Casting is on a cooldown.
descriptions.zh: 在短时内可获取提升的暴击几率和能量恢复，每消灭一名敌人都可以延长「阴极泰来」的持续时间。施放后进入技能冷却时间。

descriptions.en: Gyre’s mechanisms spin at incredible speeds, generating an Electric Field that shocks nearby enemies. When Gyre gets a critical hit, a large electrical discharge will chain from the enemy that was hit to nearby enemies.
descriptions.zh: 电光舞者的机械装置会以令人难以置信的速度高速旋转产生一个电场，并电击附近的敌人。当电光舞者造成暴击后，被击中的敌人处会产生一个巨大的电流来攻击附近的敌人。

descriptions.en: Launch a Gyratory Sphere that will deal high damage on impact and periodically deal electrical shocks to nearby enemies. Hit multiple enemies at once with the initial launch to enhance damage.
descriptions.zh: 发射一颗回旋球体，在撞击时造成大量伤害，并且可以定期对周围的敌人产生电击。在初始发射时一次性击中多名敌人来提升伤害。

descriptions.en: Throw forward a Gyratory Sphere that will implode after a few seconds or can be manually triggered.
descriptions.zh: 扔出一颗会在几秒后向内爆炸的回旋球体，或是手动触发。

descriptions.en: Booby trap nearby objects while conjuring an irresistible jewel that bursts with radial blind when touched in darkness, or a radial explosion in light. Conjure multiple smaller jewels with the help of Hall of Mirrors.
descriptions.zh: 将附近物品变成诡雷的同时变出一个令敌人难以抗拒的宝石。在黑暗处触碰宝石会爆裂造成范围致盲，在光亮处则产生范围爆炸。通过鬼影重重的帮助能施放出数个小宝石。

descriptions.en: Mirage creates an entourage of doppelgangers to confuse and distract the enemy.
descriptions.zh: 魅影精灵创造随行的分身以混淆视听并引开敌人。

descriptions.en:
(TAP) Temporarily reduce the damage Mirage takes from enemies.
(HOLD) Temporarily increase Mirage's weapon damage.
descriptions.zh:
（短按）暂时减少敌人对魅影精灵造成的伤害。
（长按）暂时增加魅影精灵的武器伤害。

descriptions.en: Fires an energy prism that shoots lasers in all directions. Activating again detonates the prism, blinding nearby foes.
descriptions.zh: 放出一个四处发射激光的能量球。再次激活此技能可以引爆炸弹，并致盲附近的敌人。

descriptions.en: Exude might and valor. Rise into the air and throw a barrage of Axios Javelins. The javelins deal damage to nearby enemies wherever they land. Direct hits to enemies deal greater damage.
descriptions.zh: 彰显力量与勇气。跃至空中并连续投掷崇敬标枪。标枪无论是否落地都可以对附近的敌人造成伤害。直接命中敌人将造成更高伤害。

descriptions.en: Summon Tharros, the shield of Styanax. Swing Tharros to repel enemies and reduce their shields and armor. Styanax regenerates health for every enemy struck.
descriptions.zh: 召唤豪勇，无畏斗士之盾。挥舞豪勇击退敌人并减少他们的护盾和护甲。每击中一名敌人，无畏斗士都会恢复生命值。

descriptions.en: Throw an Axios Javelin. When the javelin impales an enemy against a wall, surrounding enemies are pulled into the area and suffer a burst of damage.
descriptions.zh: 投掷一支崇敬标枪。当标枪将敌人钉在墙上时，周围的敌人会被拉近并遭受爆发式伤害。

descriptions.en: Draw enemy attention to Styanax. His resolve uplifts him and nearby allies, regenerating the squad's energy over time. Styanax and his allies also regenerate shields for every kill assist they contribute.
descriptions.zh: 将敌人的注意力引向无畏斗士。他的决心会鼓舞附近的友军和自己，使其随时间恢复能量。无畏斗士和他的队友每次杀敌助攻都会恢复护盾。

descriptions.en: Bind to a target with parasitic link. When cast on an ally, both the host and Nidus have their Ability Strength and Weapon Damage increased. Linked enemies take some of the damage inflicted on Nidus.
descriptions.zh: 以寄生链接绑定目标。施展对象为友军时，异变之巢与宿主的技能强度和武器伤害都会提升；连结至敌方时，宿主可为异变之巢承受部分伤害。

descriptions.en: Gluttonous maggots swarm nearby enemies, feasting until they are hit with Virulence and burst with Infestation. The maggots benefit from Mutation and each enemy hit adds to the Mutation stack.
descriptions.zh: 异常贪婪的蛆虫群包围敌人并据以为食，直到敌人被「致病力」命中并在身上爆发感染为止。突变适性对蛆虫有增益效果，而每击中一名敌人会增加突变适性的累积。

descriptions.en: Rupture the ground with a damaging fungal growth that steals energy from each enemy it strikes. For every five enemies hit, the Infestation mutates, multiplying its destructive force.
descriptions.zh: 地面瞬间迸裂出有害的菌状生长物，从被击中的每个敌人身上吸取能量。每击中五名敌人便会使感染突变，倍化其破坏力。

descriptions.en: Spawn an Infested pod that erupts with tendrils, latches onto nearby enemies and pulls them in. Enemies killed while held have a chance of generating a Mutation stack.
descriptions.zh: 生成一个迸裂出卷须的感染荚囊，紧抓附近的敌人并把他们拖入其中。在此期间被消灭的敌人有几率产生一层突变适性。

descriptions.en: Tie nearby enemies to floating balloons that douse them with Inkblot. Pop the balloons to send them crashing to the ground, splashing damage on nearby enemies.
descriptions.zh: 将附近的敌人绑在漂浮的气球上，气球会向他们喷洒墨蚀。戳破气球，敌人会坠落到地面，飞溅的墨汁会对附近的敌人造成伤害。

descriptions.en: Draw an ink effigy to absorb the damage dealt to Follie and allies. Below, a pool of ink spreads Inkblot. Kill enemies inside the pool to grow Follie's effigy and its ink puddle.
descriptions.zh: 绘制墨像来吸收狂墨和友军所受的伤害。在其下方的墨池会挥洒出墨蚀效果。击杀敌人可使狂墨的墨像及墨池的规模不断扩大。

descriptions.en: Drop through an inky frame and emerge invulnerable at the aimed location in a splash of ink that inflicts Inkblot on nearby enemies.
descriptions.zh: 穿过墨色框架，在目标地点以无敌的飞溅的墨汁出现，对附近敌人施加墨蚀效果。

descriptions.en:
Bring shadowgraphs from Follie's sketchbook to life as items that can be used for tactical advantage. Shadowgraphs splash Inkblot onto nearby enemies when created.

HOLD to open the Shadowgraph gear wheel.
descriptions.zh:
将狂墨绘影集中的绘影图变为具有战术优势的道具。绘影图生成时会向附近敌人施加墨蚀效果。

长按可打开绘影图轮盘。

descriptions.en: Create a shield aura around allies. Enemies that approach Hildryn will take <DT_RADIATION_COLOR>Radiation Damage.
descriptions.zh: 在友军周围创造一道护盾光环。敌人会在靠近重装武神时受到 <DT_RADIATION_COLOR>辐射伤害。

descriptions.en: Charge and launch devastating bolts of electricity.
descriptions.zh: 蓄力并迸发毁灭性的闪电火焰。

descriptions.en: Take the skies and rain Balefire rockets down on the enemy. Nearby enemies are blasted into the air where they will create an Energy Orb every few seconds. When shields run out the enemies are smashed into the ground.
descriptions.zh: 升上天空并对敌人降下野火火箭。附近的敌人会被炸向空中，且每隔数秒就会在他们身上生成一颗能量球。当护盾耗尽后敌人将被摔回地面。

descriptions.en: Pillage a percentage of Shields and Armor of nearby enemies to replenish Hildryn's own Shields and Overshields. Also removes Status Effects from Hildryn and her allies.
descriptions.zh: 掠夺邻近敌人一定比例的护盾与装甲，用以补充自身的护盾与超载护盾。这也会移除重装武神和她队友的异常状态。

descriptions.en: Nyx releases a devastating psychic pulse, disorienting enemies in a wide radius and forcing them to turn on each other. Confused foes lash out at random factions.
descriptions.zh: 冥河夜神释放毁灭性的精神脉冲，使大范围内的敌人迷失方向，并迫使他们自相残杀。困惑的敌人会随机攻击不同派系。

descriptions.en: Nyx unleashes a volley of psychic bolts that track and strike nearby enemies with telekinetic precision. When enemies are slain, additional bolts scatter to new targets. Striking foes weakens their defenses and transfers a portion to Nyx.
descriptions.zh: 冥河夜神释放出一连串精神飞刃，通过意念操控来精准追踪并攻击附近的敌人。击杀敌人后，额外的飞刃会散射到新的目标上。命中敌人会削弱他们的防御，并将一部分防御转移给冥河夜神。

descriptions.en: Nyx seizes control of a target's mind, compelling them to fight for the Tenno cause. Controlled enemies have increased <DT_RADIATION_COLOR>Radiation Status Chance. When Nyx shoots them, they also have an increased Damage Multiplier.
descriptions.zh: 冥河夜神控制目标的思想，迫使他们为天诺效力。被控制的敌人会增加 <DT_RADIATION_COLOR>辐射触发几率。当冥河夜神射击他们时，伤害倍率也会增加。

descriptions.en: Nyx draws in and contains the damage dealt to her and the damage confused enemies deal to each other then converts it into a devastating radial blast. Following the blast, she enters a brief invulnerable state and gains a Weapon Damage boost proportional to the absorbed damage.
descriptions.zh: 冥河夜神吸收对她造成的伤害，以及困惑的敌人之间造成的伤害，然后将其转化为一道毁灭性的范围爆炸。爆炸后，她将进入短暂的无敌状态，并根据吸收的伤害增加武器伤害。

descriptions.en: Weave a dome of living chain that ensnares and strangles any enemy within, and any foolish enough to approach. Foes outside the trap will try to hasten their comrade's deaths by shooting them. Crack Whipclaw on the dome to further damage any trapped enemies.
descriptions.zh: 编织出一张活动的锁链穹顶，禁锢并勒住其中的敌人和胆敢接近的蠢货。在穹顶外部的敌人会借由试着射击他们的同袍来加速其灭亡；使用长鞭利爪击打穹顶可使其伤害遍及至任何被困住的敌人身上。

descriptions.en: Send enemies reeling with a deafening whipcrack. Stats are boosted by the equipped mods on Whipclaw.
descriptions.zh: 在欲聋的鞭打声中将敌人击退。装备在「长鞭利爪」的振幅晶体可以增强技能威力。

descriptions.en: Command Venari to focus on a target. Hold to cycle between Attack, Protect, and Heal postures. If Venari is killed, use this ability to revive her instantly.
descriptions.zh: 命令薇娜丽专注于一名目标；按住技能来切换攻击，保护和治疗形态；若薇娜丽阵亡，使用此技能可以立即复活她。

descriptions.en: Bind a hapless target in living metal, entangling others who stray too close. Whipclaw will refresh the trap allowing it to capture more enemies.
descriptions.zh: 使用活性金属来束缚住一名倒霉的目标，并将缠绕过度靠近的敌人。以长鞭利爪击打可以刷新陷阱来捆绑更多敌人。

descriptions.en:
Surround yourself with Omamori Charms, each with a chance to have enemy attacks heal you instead of damage you. The number of charms is determined by Koumei's dice roll.

A roll of triple sixes grants invulnerability for the duration of your Omamori Charms.
descriptions.zh:
让御守护符围绕自己，每个护符都有机会使敌人的攻击治愈你，而非伤害你。护符的数量取决于御命织姬的掷骰结果。

掷出三个六则在御守护符激活期间提供无敌效果。

descriptions.en:
Koumei glimpses a favorable future and the precise steps needed to reach it. Complete the challenge to earn a Decree. Unlucky rolls add a debuff, but you can hold the ability to reject the Omikuji.

A roll of triple sixes grants a Decree without a challenge.
descriptions.zh:
御命织姬预视到了一个美好的未来以及实现它的具体步骤。完成挑战即可获得王令。运气不好的掷骰结果会带来一种减益，但你可以长按技能键以放弃该御神签。

掷出三个六则可以直接获得王令，无需挑战。

descriptions.en:
Wield your foe’s fate threads like the strings of marionettes. Koumei’s dice determine how many Status Effects foes in front of Koumei will suffer.

A roll of triple sixes causes further Status Effects over time and extends Bunraku to enemies behind Koumei.
descriptions.zh:
像操纵牵线木偶一样操纵敌人的命运之线。御命织姬的骰子决定了御命织姬面前的敌人将承受的异常状态数量。

掷出三个六会造成持续的额外异常状态，并将人偶戏效果延伸到御命织姬背后的敌人。

descriptions.en:
Weave the threads of destiny. Enemies who touch the threads suffer a random Elemental Status Effect.

A roll of triple sixes creates threads that inflict one of every Elemental Status Effect.
descriptions.zh:
编织命运之线。触碰命运之线的敌人会受到随机元素异常状态的影响。

投掷出三个六点会产生可以造成所有元素异常状态的线。

descriptions.en: Loki deploys a holographic copy of himself that draws enemy fire. The decoy gains health and shield based on enemies nearby.
descriptions.zh: 邪神洛基会部署一个自己的全息复制体来吸引敌人的火力。分身会根据附近敌人的数量获得生命值和护盾。

descriptions.en: Loki camouflages himself, becoming invisible to enemies.
descriptions.zh: 邪神洛基伪装自身，让自己在敌人面前隐形。

descriptions.en: Lets forth a wave of energy, disrupting the projectile weapons of enemies in range and forcing them to revert to melee combat.
descriptions.zh: 释放一道能量波，解除范围内敌人的射击武器，迫使他们使用近战。

descriptions.en: Loki instantaneously swaps positions with a target, confusing the enemy.
descriptions.zh: 邪神洛基瞬间和目标交换位置，迷惑敌人。

descriptions.en:
(TAP) Enclose a target in a magnetic field that ensnares nearby enemies and deals damage over time. The field pulls Polarize Shards that orbited Mag and shrapnel into the deadly mix.
(HOLD) Mag surrounds herself in a magnetic field that absorbs ranged attacks and reflects damage back in a destructive cone.
descriptions.zh:
（轻按）将目标封闭在磁场中，在一段时间内困住附近的敌人，并对其造成伤害。该磁场会吸引环绕磁力运动的「护盾极化碎片」和飞溅的弹片进行致命混合。
（长按）磁力将自己包裹在一个磁场中，吸收远程攻击，并在一个破坏性锥型域内返还伤害。

descriptions.en: Magnetize the bones of nearby enemies, causing them to collapse upon themselves.
descriptions.zh: 磁化附近的敌军的骨头，导致它们自我崩坏。

descriptions.en: Mag stuns enemies as she manifests a magnetic vortex. The vortex pulls in Polarize Shards and stunned enemies to place them directly in front of her.
descriptions.zh: 磁力所制造出的磁力漩涡会晕眩敌人。漩涡会将「护盾极化碎片」和被震晕的敌人拉近，并将他们放置在她面前。

descriptions.en: Emit an energy pulse that depletes enemy shields and armor as it restores ally shields. Debris left over from the pulse becomes Polarize Shards. Nearby Polarize Shards orbit Mag and cut enemies, inflicting <DT_SLASH_COLOR>Slash Status Effect.
descriptions.zh: 发射一道能量脉冲，在耗尽敌人护盾和护甲的同时恢复队友护盾。脉冲留下的碎片会形成「护盾极化碎片」。附近的「护盾极化碎片」会环绕磁力并切割敌人，造成 <DT_SLASH_COLOR>切割异常状态。

descriptions.en: Casts a wave of Rift energy that damages hostiles while pushing enemies and allies out of Limbo's current plane of existence.
descriptions.zh: 释放一道裂隙能量波来伤害敌人，同时将敌人与队友从灵薄狱目前所在的位面中推出去。

descriptions.en: Freezes Rift-bound enemies. While active, enemy projectiles are arrested in mid-air, resuming its trajectory when stasis ends.
descriptions.zh: 使被裂隙束缚的敌人静止。当其激活时，敌人的子弹将会被截停在半空中，停滞结束后这些子弹将会按照原先的弹道继续行进。

descriptions.en: A violent blast of Void energy tears open a pocket of rift plane which can sustain itself for a short period before collapsing in another lethal blast.
descriptions.zh: 借由虚空能量的猛烈爆炸撕开一个裂隙位面空间，此空间能短暂持续至下一次致命爆炸发生。

descriptions.en: Surges nearby Rift-bound enemies with Rift energy. When killed the Rift Surge is transferred to a nearby enemy outside the rift. Surged enemies that leave the Rift perform a radial Banish.
descriptions.zh: 用裂隙能量涌流冲击附近被裂隙困住的敌人。被消灭时裂隙涌流会被传递到涌流外的一名附近的敌人上。被涌流影响的敌人若离开裂隙，将会引起一个范围​​放逐。

descriptions.en: Evaporate into a cloud of mist and float through the battlefield, dazing any enemies encountered, while healing Wukong and his twin.
descriptions.zh: 化身为一团云雾，飘过战场，在令沿途的敌人陷入眩晕的同时治疗齐天大圣和他的分身。

descriptions.en:
Wukong and his twin become invulnerable and defy enemies to attack. All damage is captured, stored, and dealt back in a single furious strike of Wukong's staff.
Bonus Armor is then granted relative to the damage captured.
descriptions.zh:
齐天大圣和他的分身进入无敌状态，同时嘲讽敌人，吸引火力。在此期间受到的所有伤害都会被积攒起来，而后齐天大圣会以一记狂怒的棍击将其释放。
根据积攒的伤害量，齐天大圣还会得到额外护甲。

descriptions.en:
Shedding part of himself, Wukong creates a twin to fight by his side. Attack at range and the twin will melee, pull a blade and the twin will lay down covering fire.
Use again to command the twin to attack a target with increased damage.
descriptions.zh:
齐天大圣拔出一根毫毛，以此来制造出一个共同作战的分身。本体使用远程攻击时，分身就会发动近战攻击，而当本体拔出刀剑之时，分身则会进行掩护射击。
再次使用技能即可命令分身对某个目标发动强化攻击。

descriptions.en: Explode the iron staff to its true length, knocking down anything in its path.
descriptions.zh: 将定海神针恢复为原本的尺寸，打翻攻击路径上的所有敌人。

descriptions.en: Summon the iron staff and unleash fury.
descriptions.zh: 召唤出定海神针并释放猴王的怒火。

descriptions.en: Summon shadow versions of vanquished enemies to fight alongside you for a short period.
descriptions.zh: 召唤已击毙敌人的幽影在短时间内一起作战。

descriptions.en: Forces fallen enemies around you to drop additional loot.
descriptions.zh: 亵渎亡者尸体，从中搜取额外物品。

descriptions.en: A blow so powerful, it turns the enemy's very soul into a deadly projectile, damaging all in its path. Enemies that survive the blow are Marked for Harvest and become one of Nekros' Shadows of the Dead if killed while marked.
descriptions.zh: 如此强烈的打击，把敌人的灵魂化为致命弹头，来杀伤其经过路线上的一切。在这一击中幸存下来的敌人会被标记以待收割，如果敌人在处于标记时被消灭，他就会成为御魂主宰「亡者幽影」中的一员。

descriptions.en: Cast fear into the hearts of nearby enemies, causing them to run away in terror.
descriptions.zh: 将恐惧感深植周遭敌人心中，使他们于恐惧之中逃窜。

descriptions.en: Hurl a flaming ring that sets enemies ablaze making them vulnerable to any damage. Flaming enemies drop Restorative Orbs on death. Charge to amplify the power of the ring, and reactivate to instantly travel to the ring's location.
descriptions.zh: 掷出一个可点燃敌人的火圈，使敌人更易受到伤害。燃烧的敌人可掉落恢复球。蓄力可增强火圈的力量，再次激活技能可瞬间传送至火圈的位置。

descriptions.en: Create a protective ring of fire, that also stuns and damages enemies who get too close.
descriptions.zh: 制造出守护火环，对靠近的敌人造成伤害并晕眩。

descriptions.en: Impale nearby enemies on spears that erupt from the below. Activate again to slam surviving enemies back into the ground.
descriptions.zh: 用破地而出的长矛将附近的敌人刺起。再次使用技能可以将幸存的敌人猛拍回地面。

descriptions.en: Blaze a trail of flames, scorching enemies and cleansing allies. Teleporting blasts the landing area with a ring of fire.
descriptions.zh: 点燃一道火焰的路径，烧灼敌人并净化友军。传送时可在落地点产生火圈爆破。

descriptions.en: Launches a spinning blade of pain, dealing high damage and impaling enemies to walls.
descriptions.zh: 掷出一枚旋转的手里剑，造成高伤害并把敌人钉在墙上。

descriptions.en: Project fierce Shadow Clones of Ash upon groups of distant enemies. Join the fray using Teleport. The Shadow Clones can be upgraded with mods.
descriptions.zh: 将灰烬之刃的凶猛影分身投入远处的敌群中。使用「瞬移」可以主动加入这场厮杀。幻影分身可通过振幅晶体来升级。

descriptions.en: Drops a smoke bomb that stuns enemies and obscures their vision, rendering Ash invisible for a short time.
descriptions.zh: 扔出烟雾弹眩晕敌人并阻碍其视线，同时灰烬之刃进入短暂的隐身状态。

descriptions.en: Teleport to a target and perform a Finisher. If the finisher kills the target, Ash regains a portion of the energy spent.
descriptions.zh: 瞬移至目标并进行处决。如果处决击杀目标，将为灰烬之刃恢复一部分消耗的能量。

descriptions.en: Unleash a chaotic ballistic mushroom that seeks enemies and bounces explosively off whatever it touches. Contact with any of Nokko’s mushrooms invigorates them, doubling their pulse rate.
descriptions.zh: 释放一个混乱的弹道蘑菇，会追踪敌人并在触碰目标后爆炸反弹。接触蘑菇小子的任何蘑菇都会使其活化，脉冲频率翻倍。

descriptions.en: Release a rejuvenating mushroom that emits a radial pulse, giving Nokko and his allies' <ENERGY> Energy and applying a buff to Ability Strength that lasts for a short time.
descriptions.zh: 释放一个可以发出放射脉冲波的复苏蘑菇，给予蘑菇小子及其友军 <ENERGY> 能量，并在短时间内对技能强度施加增益。

descriptions.en: Revert to Sprodling form, spawning orbs that heal Nokko and grant a speed boost. While in this state, Nokko is untargetable and heals gradually.
descriptions.zh: 恢复为菌宝形态，生成使蘑菇小子快速愈合和加速的球体。在此状态下，蘑菇小子无法被选为攻击目标并且会逐渐恢复。

descriptions.en: Throw a mushroom that periodically sheds poisonous spores, inflicting <DT_VIRAL_COLOR> Viral Damage and Status Effect upon nearby enemies while also lulling them to sleep.
descriptions.zh: 扔出一个周期性释放有毒孢子的蘑菇，对附近的敌人造成 <DT_VIRAL_COLOR>病毒伤害和异常状态，同时使他们陷入睡眠状态。

descriptions.en: Nyx draws in and contains the damage dealt to her and the damage confused enemies deal to each other then converts it into a devastating radial blast. Following the blast, she enters a brief invulnerable state and gains a Weapon Damage boost proportional to the absorbed damage.
descriptions.zh: 冥河夜神吸收对她造成的伤害，以及困惑的敌人之间造成的伤害，然后将其转化为一道毁灭性的范围爆炸。爆炸后，她将进入短暂的无敌状态，并根据吸收的伤害增加武器伤害。

descriptions.en: Drops a smoke bomb that stuns enemies and obscures their vision, rendering Ash invisible for a short time.
descriptions.zh: 扔出烟雾弹眩晕敌人并阻碍其视线，同时灰烬之刃进入短暂的隐身状态。

descriptions.en: Rhino charges towards a target, clobbering any in his path and goring his victim.
descriptions.zh: 狂野犀牛向目标冲锋，击倒突进路径上的一切阻碍，并以犀角强烈顶击目标。

descriptions.en: Launch a voltaic projectile that stuns and damages its target. A chain of electricity extends from the target to shock nearby enemies.
descriptions.zh: 发射一个能击晕并伤害目标的伏电射弹。一串电弧以目标为中心，散发式电击附近的敌人。

descriptions.en: Rhino hardens his skin, insulating himself from all damage and gaining Overguard.
descriptions.zh: 狂野犀牛硬化他的皮肤，隔绝一切伤害并获得超宏防护。

descriptions.en:
Shedding part of himself, Wukong creates a twin to fight by his side. Attack at range and the twin will melee, pull a blade and the twin will lay down covering fire.
Use again to command the twin to attack a target with increased damage.
descriptions.zh:
齐天大圣拔出一根毫毛，以此来制造出一个共同作战的分身。本体使用远程攻击时，分身就会发动近战攻击，而当本体拔出刀剑之时，分身则会进行掩护射击。
再次使用技能即可命令分身对某个目标发动强化攻击。

descriptions.en: Kullervo surrounds himself with daggers. Each dagger that strikes an enemy restores his health, but each dagger that misses an enemy strikes Kullervo, dealing a bit of damage. When Kullervo has max Health, he receives Overguard from struck enemies.
descriptions.zh: 刀锋囚徒用匕首包围自己。每一把击中敌人的匕首都会恢复他的生命值，但每一把未击中敌人的匕首都会攻击刀锋囚徒，对他造成少量伤害。刀锋囚徒拥有满生命值时，会在击中敌人时获得超宏防护。

descriptions.en: Kullervo sends forth a curse that binds enemies. When a cursed enemy takes damage from him, every other cursed enemy also suffers a portion of that damage.
descriptions.zh: 刀锋囚徒发出一道诅咒束缚住敌人。当一个被诅咒的敌人受到来自他的伤害时，其他被诅咒的敌人也会受到相应的一部分伤害。

descriptions.en: Hurl a canister of graviton fluids to create a wide mire that will significantly slow enemies traveling across it. Alternatively, the canister can be shot in mid-air to create a fiery conflagration.
descriptions.zh: 抛出一罐引力液体来制造一片宽阔的泥沼，在泥沼上行进的敌人会大大减速。此外，也可以将罐子射向半空来制造烈焰。

descriptions.en: Swathe the Necramech in a powerful electrical field that greatly enhances survivability in close combat. Enemies that strike the shroud will suffer for their impudence.
descriptions.zh: 将殁世机甲笼罩在一道强力电场中，以大幅提升近战时的生存能力。击中这一电场罩的敌人会为他们的无礼付出代价。

descriptions.zh: 将浸泡在暴食者体内消化液里的一个敌人猛烈吐出，让这个被吞噬的生物成为一团毒素投射物，并基于敌人的最大生命值造成额外伤害。其消化液会使附近的敌人减速，并且会溶解他们的护甲。

descriptions.zh: 刀锋囚徒发出一道诅咒束缚住敌人。当一个被诅咒的敌人受到来自他的伤害时，其他被诅咒的敌人也会受到相应的一部分伤害。

descriptions.zh: 地面瞬间迸裂出有害的菌状生长物，从被击中的每个敌人身上吸取能量。每击中五名敌人便会使感染突变，倍化其破坏力。

descriptions.en: Exhales a deep breath of elemental destruction.
descriptions.zh: 释放出毁灭性的元素吐息。

descriptions.zh: 强力践踏以扰乱时间秩序，并使周围的敌人陷入停滞状态。

descriptions.zh: 剧毒之触脱落如蛇般的皮肤，在身后留下诱饵吸引敌人的火力。

Erect a containment field to capture enemies and suspend them in stasis, stripping their armor and granting it to Vauban and any allies within Bastille's field.

HOLD to collapse all Bastilles into a single damaging vortex.

descriptions.zh: 〈黑夜形态〉时降低周围敌人造成的伤害。〈白昼形态〉时则增加附近友军的技能强度。

descriptions.en: In Night-Form, allies' Shields are replenished with each nearby enemy killed. In Day-Form, enemies are inflicted with <DT_SLASH_COLOR>Slash Status Effect. Deactivate while in Night-Form to restore Health and Shields for Equinox and allies. Deactivate while in Day-Form to cast a wave of slashing force.
descriptions.zh: 〈黑夜型态〉在附近被消灭的每一名敌人都能使友军恢复护盾。〈白昼型态〉使附近敌人陷入 <DT_SLASH_COLOR>切割异常状态，在〈黑夜型态〉时停用技能来为阴阳双子及友军恢复生命及护盾。在〈白昼型态〉时停用技能来释放出一波切割之力。

descriptions.zh: 昼夜交替：〈黑夜形态〉暂时获得额外护盾和护甲；〈白昼形态〉暂时获得额外伤害和速度。
