descriptions.zh: 〈黑夜形态〉使目标敌人陷入沉睡；〈白昼形态〉对目标敌人造成更多伤害。

descriptions.en: Launch a voltaic projectile that stuns and damages its target. A chain of electricity extends from the target to shock nearby enemies.
descriptions.zh: 发射一个能击晕并伤害目标的伏电射弹。一串电弧以目标为中心，散发式电击附近的敌人。

descriptions.en:
Drops a Temporal Anchor which, after a short duration, Protea rewinds to trigger a temporal implosion. Implosion damage increases based on damage dealt between anchor drop and rewind. Everything lost or expended in that time is returned.
Dying while Anchor is active rewinds Protea to the anchor, saving her. Protea is knocked down and the anchor vanishes.
descriptions.zh:
放置一个「时泊之锚」后的一段时间，泊时灵械可以把这段时间回溯，来触发一个时空内爆。该内爆伤害会根据从泊时灵械放置「时泊之锚」的时候起到回溯的时候为止，这段时间造成的伤害而增加。在此期间丢失或使用的任何物品都会被退还给玩家。
在「时泊之锚」被激活状态时阵亡的话，启用回溯会使泊时灵械回到过去，从而使其免于阵亡。泊时灵械仍会处于击倒状态，而「时泊之锚」也会消失。

descriptions.en: Deploys an artillery unit to blast plasma charges at enemies it faces. Each enemy hit increases the power of subsequent plasma attacks.
descriptions.zh: 部署一个火炮单位来向其面向的敌人发射炸裂的等离子电浆。每击中一名敌人都会增加后续等离子攻击的威力。

descriptions.en: Deploys a device that generates 3 pickups after a short delay: empowered health orb, universal ammo pack and energy orb.
descriptions.zh: 部署一个装置，片刻之后可产生 3 种拾取物：强化生命球、通用弹药补给包和能量球。

descriptions.en:
Throw out grenades in an arc.

(TAP) SHRAPNEL VORTEX
Creates a slashing, staggering swirl of shrapnel.

(HOLD) SHIELD SATELLITES
Protea reconfigures Grenades to work as overcharging shield generators, protecting her, her allies and companions. When Shields break, a Satellite is destroyed to double minimum Shield Gate invincibility time.
descriptions.zh:
投掷弧线飞行的手雷。

（轻按）破片漩涡
产生一道锋利无比的弹片漩涡。

（长按）护盾卫星
泊时灵械重设手雷，使其变为超载护盾充能器，以保护她自身、她的友军和同伴。当泊时灵械的护盾被击穿时，一台守护她的卫星会被摧毁以加倍延长其最小护盾保险的无敌时间。

descriptions.en:
Unfurl Oraxia's spider legs and go on the prowl. Oraxia is immune to Status Effects and has increased Maximum Health. Ranged Weapons are imbued with <DT_POISON_COLOR> Toxin Damage. Killing enemies causes them to burst with <DT_POISON_COLOR>Toxin.

Silken Thread: Tap Dodge to leap to a targeted surface.
descriptions.zh:
展开缚影蛛后的蜘蛛腿，开始狩猎。缚影蛛后免疫异常状态并提升最大生命值。她的远程武器充满 <DT_POISON_COLOR>毒素伤害。击杀敌人会使其爆发 <DT_POISON_COLOR>毒素。

蛛丝游走：轻按冲刺即可跳跃至目标表面。

descriptions.en: Oraxia throws a creeping web to ensnare her prey. Enemies caught within the widening radius are trapped inside a cocoon that increases their Damage Vulnerability.
descriptions.zh: 缚影蛛后投掷一张蔓延的蛛网，将猎物困住。在不断扩大的蛛网中被捕住的敌人会被困在茧中，并使其受到的易伤效果增加。

descriptions.en: Leap onto an enemy and pierce them with Oraxia’s spider legs, dealing <DT_POISON_COLOR>Toxin Damage. Enemies defeated by this attack have a chance to drop Health or Energy Orbs.
descriptions.zh: 跳到敌人身上，用缚影蛛后的蜘蛛腿刺穿他们，造成 <DT_POISON_COLOR>毒素伤害。用这个攻击击败敌人时，他们将有几率掉落生命球或能量球。

descriptions.en: Oraxia launches a barrage of stinging darts in front of her that applies <DT_POISON_COLOR> Toxin Status Effect. Poisoned enemies spawn Scuttlers when killed.
descriptions.zh: 缚影蛛后向她前方发射一连串带刺的飞镖，并施加 <DT_POISON_COLOR>毒素异常状态。中毒的敌人被击杀后会生成急行蛛。

descriptions.en: Summon a bevy of orbiting daggers to seek out enemy guns, destroying them with a small explosion. Combine with Elude to double the range.
descriptions.zh: 召唤一群环绕的匕首并寻找敌人的枪支，用小型爆炸来摧毁它们。与「巧躲」结合来使范围加倍。

descriptions.en: Dodge all incoming projectiles, but only while not attacking. Use again to deactivate this ability.
descriptions.zh: 只处于没攻击时可闪避所有飞来的子弹。再使用一次可关闭该技能。

descriptions.en: With his Restraint eroded, Baruuk commands the Desert Wind to deliver powerful radial strikes with his fists and feet. Each moment commanding the storm restores his Restraint.
descriptions.zh: 随着他的「克制」被侵蚀，圣拳武僧用「宁静风暴」来使拳脚作出强大的范围攻击。掌握风暴的每一刻会使他恢复「克制」。

descriptions.en: A calming wave slows enemies until they fall into a slumber. Enemies woken by damage will be confused and disoriented. Short-term amnesia means all waking enemies forget anything that happened before the lull.
descriptions.zh: 平静的波浪使敌人速度变慢直到陷入沉睡。被击伤而苏醒的敌人会感到困惑和迷失。短暂的健忘意味着所有醒来的敌人都会忘记沉睡之前所发生的任何事。

descriptions.en: Open Noctua, Dante's Exalted Tome, and unleash a tale of woe upon his enemies.
descriptions.zh: 翻开缮写士的显赫典籍——夜枭，向他的敌人释放悲剧。

descriptions.en: Dante's composition draws blood from nearby enemies, inflicting <DT_SLASH_COLOR>Slash Damage upon them.
descriptions.zh: 缮写士的诗句从周围敌人身上抽出血液，对他们造成 <DT_SLASH_COLOR>切割伤害。

descriptions.en:
Dante must compose two other Verses before his Final Verse. TRIUMPH: Two Light Verses cast in succession invigorate allies with a buff that increases Health and grants Overguard. Kills and assists briefly regenerate Overguard.
Dante must compose two other Verses before his Final Verse. TRAGEDY: Two Dark Verses cast in succession attack enemies. Damage Over Time from Slash, Heat and Toxin Status Effects accumulates in a single blast.
Dante must compose two other Verses before his Final Verse. WORDWARDEN: A Light Verse followed by a Dark Verse supports allies with copies of Noctua. Noctua copies synchronize their attacks with their designated ally’s attacks.
Dante must compose two other Verses before his Final Verse. PAGEFLIGHT: A Dark Verse followed by a Light Verse summons Paragrimms that swoop at enemies, making them vulnerable to Status Chance and Status Damage, as well as drawing enemy attacks away from allies.
descriptions.zh:
缮写士必须在他的「最终诗篇」之前创作另外两首诗句。 胜利：连续施放两个「明之诗句」能够振奋友军，为他们提供增加生命值并赋予超宏防护的增益效果。消灭和助攻会短暂恢复超宏防护。
缮写士必须在他的「最终诗篇」之前创作另外两首诗句。 悲剧：连续施放两个「暗之诗句」能够攻击敌人。来自 切割、火焰和 毒素异常状态造成的持续伤害将累积成一次性的爆发。
缮写士必须在他的「最终诗篇」之前创作另外两首诗句。 守词者：「明之诗句」后跟着「暗之诗句」，将以夜枭分身为友军提供支援。夜枭分身会与其指定友军同步进行攻击。
缮写士必须在他的「最终诗篇」之前创作另外两首诗句。 书页飞羽：「暗之诗句」后跟着「明之诗句」可召唤幽幽鹰扑向敌人，使他们易受触发几率和异常状态伤害的影响，并将敌人的攻击从友军身上转移。

descriptions.en: Dante's vitalizing composition grants him and his allies Overguard and restores their Health.
descriptions.zh: 缮写士的活力之作赋予他和他的友军超宏防护，并恢复他们的生命值。

descriptions.en: Lifts enemies into the air and then hurls them down with conviction, removing their Armor. Enemies hit by this ability will grant Oberon additional Armor and have a chance to spawn a <HEALTH>Health Orb when they die.
descriptions.zh: 将附近的敌人迅速举到空中，然后将其狠狠摔下。被该技能击中的会为龙王奥伯提供额外护甲，并在死亡时有几率掉落生命球。

descriptions.en: Generates a protective aura that grants bonus Armor to Oberon and his allies and restores allies’ Health over time. Healing is doubled while within the radius of Hallowed Ground.
descriptions.zh: 生成一道保护光环，为龙王奥伯及其友军提供护甲加成，并持续恢复友军生命值。在「神圣领域」范围内，治疗效果翻倍。

descriptions.en: Focuses deadly energy within a target, dealing massive damage and removing all of its defenses, including Overguard. Enemies near the target also take a portion of the damage.
descriptions.zh: 将致命能量聚集于目标，造成巨大伤害并移除其所有防御，包括超宏防护。目标附近的敌人也会受到部分伤害。

descriptions.en: Sanctifies the ground around Oberon, inflicting <DT_RADIATION_COLOR>Radiation Damage to all enemies within the radius. Also grants protection against Status Effects for Oberon and his allies.
descriptions.zh: 圣化龙王奥伯周围的地面，对范围内的所有敌人造成 <DT_RADIATION_COLOR>辐射伤害。同时保护龙王奥伯及其友军免受异常状态影响。

descriptions.en: Kullervo surrounds himself with daggers. Each dagger that strikes an enemy restores his health, but each dagger that misses an enemy strikes Kullervo, dealing a bit of damage. When Kullervo has max Health, he receives Overguard from struck enemies.
descriptions.zh: 刀锋囚徒用匕首包围自己。每一把击中敌人的匕首都会恢复他的生命值，但每一把未击中敌人的匕首都会攻击刀锋囚徒，对他造成少量伤害。刀锋囚徒拥有满生命值时，会在击中敌人时获得超宏防护。

descriptions.en: The Void answers Kullervo's invocation with a storm of daggers that rain down upon his enemies.
descriptions.zh: 虚空以匕首雨的形式回应刀锋囚徒的呼唤，向他的敌人倾泄。

descriptions.en: Kullervo sends forth a curse that binds enemies. When a cursed enemy takes damage from him, every other cursed enemy also suffers a portion of that damage.
descriptions.zh: 刀锋囚徒发出一道诅咒束缚住敌人。当一个被诅咒的敌人受到来自他的伤害时，其他被诅咒的敌人也会受到相应的一部分伤害。

descriptions.en:
(TAP) Kullervo charges a Heavy Attack, then teleports to his target and strikes. His rage-filled focus temporarily increases his Melee Critical Chance.
(HOLD) Teleport to any marked location.
descriptions.zh:
（轻按）刀锋囚徒为重击进行蓄力，然后传送至他的目标身边并发动攻击。他那充满愤怒的集中力会暂时增加他的近战暴击几率。
（长按）传送至任何标记的地点。

descriptions.en: Summon a tempest to rain down upon a target area.
descriptions.zh: 召唤暴风雨弹炮轰目标区域。

descriptions.en: Summon a creature from the depths. Its watery tentacles emerge from nearby surfaces to wreak havoc.
descriptions.zh: 召唤一只来自深海的生物。它的水之触手从四面八方席卷而来造成严重破坏。

descriptions.en: Plunder Armor from nearby enemies and increase <DT_CORROSIVE_COLOR>Corrosive Damage on your Abilities and weapons. Enemies affected by <DT_CORROSIVE_COLOR>Corrosive Status offer a greater increase.
descriptions.zh: 从附近敌人身上掠夺护甲，并为你的技能和武器附加 <DT_CORROSIVE_COLOR>腐蚀伤害。受到 <DT_CORROSIVE_COLOR>腐蚀异常状态影响的敌人将提供更多加成。

descriptions.en: Crash through enemies in a ferocious wall of water.
descriptions.zh: 用凶猛的水墙冲垮敌人。

descriptions.en: First Ability consumes all energy to increase damage for |DURATION|s. Deal |DAMAGE|% additional damage for every percentage of energy consumed. |COOLDOWN|s cooldown.
descriptions.zh: 第一技能消耗所有能量增加伤害，持续 |DURATION| 秒。每消耗 1% 能量增加 |DAMAGE|% 伤害，冷却时间 |COOLDOWN| 秒。

descriptions.en: Restore the health and shields of allies within <AFFINITY_SHARE>Affinity Range while reducing the damage they take from enemies.
descriptions.zh: 恢复 <AFFINITY_SHARE>经验共享范围内友军的生命值和护盾，同时减少他们受到的敌人伤害。

descriptions.en: Allies will gain energy over time when enemies are marked with Energy Vampire.
descriptions.zh: 友军将在伤害被能力吸取标记的敌人同时获得能量。

descriptions.en: Any damage taken while Link is active will be channeled to a nearby enemy.
descriptions.zh: 链接激活时，一切受到的伤害将转移给身边的一个敌人。

descriptions.en: Emit an energy pulse that depletes enemy shields and armor as it restores ally shields. Debris left over from the pulse becomes Polarize Shards. Nearby Polarize Shards orbit Mag and cut enemies, inflicting <DT_SLASH_COLOR>Slash Status Effect.
descriptions.zh: 发射一道能量脉冲，在耗尽敌人护盾和护甲的同时恢复队友护盾。脉冲留下的碎片会形成「护盾极化碎片」。附近的「护盾极化碎片」会环绕磁力并切割敌人，造成 <DT_SLASH_COLOR>切割异常状态。

descriptions.en: Creates a whirling mass of energy that violently attracts nearby enemies, crushing their atoms into a tiny spec of matter.
descriptions.zh: 创造一个大规模旋转的能量，猛烈牵引附近敌人，粉碎他们的原子成微小物质。

descriptions.en: Second Ability emits a radial burst slowing any enemy it touches by |PERCENT|% for |DURATION|s.
descriptions.zh: 第二技能发射一道范围爆破，任何被触及到的敌人会被减速 |PERCENT|%，持续 |DURATION| 秒。

descriptions.en: Stun nearby enemies with strong accelerant. Increases all fire damage dealt.
descriptions.zh: 施放强力助燃可以眩晕邻近敌人，并提升对其造成的火焰伤害。

descriptions.en: Stun nearby enemies with strong accelerant. Increases all fire damage dealt.
descriptions.zh: 施放强力助燃可以眩晕邻近敌人，并提升对其造成的火焰伤害。

descriptions.en: First Ability creates a well of energy for |DURATION|s. Allies passing through the well gain |REGEN| Energy/s for |BUFFTIME|s.
descriptions.zh: 第一技能制造一个持续 |DURATION| 秒的能量区域。通过其中的友军获得每秒 |REGEN| 能量恢复，持续 |BUFFTIME| 秒。

descriptions.en: Release a poisonous miasma that deals <DT_VIRAL_COLOR>Viral Damage to enemies in range. Foes afflicted by spores are more susceptible to the mist.
descriptions.zh: 释放剧毒的瘴气，对范围内的敌人造成<DT_VIRAL_COLOR>病毒伤害。受到孢子影响的敌人会遭到毒雾更深的感染。

descriptions.en: Heal your companion and call it to your side.
descriptions.zh: 治疗你的同伴，并让它立刻回到你身边。

descriptions.en: Increase the efficiency of your ammo consumption.
descriptions.zh: 提高你的武器弹药效率。

descriptions.en: Consume Energy to heal yourself and grant matching Energy to each ally.
descriptions.zh: 消耗能量治疗自身，并使每名友军获得等值的能量。

descriptions.en: Automatically succeed at your next hack attempt.
descriptions.zh: 自动完成下一次入侵

descriptions.en: Emit a pulse that adds stacks to Status Effects already afflicting enemies. The damage of <DT_SLASH_COLOR>Slash, <DT_FIRE_COLOR>Heat, and <DT_POISON_COLOR>Toxin effects, excluding those created by Sickening Pulse itself, are added together to create a new instance of the Effect with a refreshed timer
descriptions.zh: 施放一个脉冲，为敌人身上已有的异常状态效果叠加层数。<DT_SLASH_COLOR>切割、<DT_FIRE_COLOR>火焰和 <DT_POISON_COLOR>毒素异常状态的伤害（不包括由「恶疾脉冲」自身产生的伤害）将被叠加，从而生成一个全新的异常状态效果，并重新计时

descriptions.en: Grant yourself immunity to Status effects.
descriptions.zh: 赋予自身异常状态免疫效果。

descriptions.en: Sacrifice Shields to reinforce Armor for a period of time.
descriptions.zh: 牺牲护盾以在一段时间内增强护甲。

descriptions.en: Instantly restore your shields.
descriptions.zh: 立即恢复护盾。

descriptions.en: Increase your parkour velocity.
descriptions.zh: 提高你的跑酷速度。

descriptions.en: Condense all <DT_SLASH_COLOR>Slash and <DT_POISON_COLOR>Toxin Status Effects into a single damage instance.
descriptions.zh: 将所有 <DT_SLASH_COLOR>切割和 <DT_POISON_COLOR>毒素异常状态浓缩为一个单次伤害。

descriptions.en: Increase the strength of your next ability use.
descriptions.zh: 提高下个技能的强度。

descriptions.en: Stun an enemy; a portion of the next damage you deal to it will be dealt to all enemies around it.
descriptions.zh: 击晕一个敌人，对它造成的下一发伤害的一部分也将被应用于周围所有的敌人。

descriptions.en: Send out a short-lived Void Spark that is drawn toward the nearest Medallion, Ayatan Sculpture, rare crate, unscanned Kuria or unscanned Fragment.
descriptions.zh: 发射一道短暂的虚空火花指向离你最近的集团奖章、阿耶檀识塑像、稀有储存箱、未扫描的库利亚猫神器或碎片。

descriptions.en: Release a fiery projectile that ignites enemies on contact.
descriptions.zh: 释放一个燃烧的投射物，点燃接触到的目标。

descriptions.en: Become a water trap and drown unsuspecting enemies.
descriptions.zh: 用水漩涡淹没毫无防备的敌人。

descriptions.en: Use your first Ability to create a |RADIUS|m radius field that lasts for |DURATION|s and disables the shields of any enemy that enters it.
descriptions.zh: 使用你的第一技能来创造一个半径 |RADIUS| 米的力场，持续 |DURATION| 秒，消除所有力场内敌人的护盾。

descriptions.en: Use your first Ability to manifest a barrier on the Operator and allies in Affinity Range. It is invulnerable for 4s when first created and damage inflicted while it's invulnerable will be added to its base health of |HEALTH|.
descriptions.zh: 使用你的第一技能来为指挥官和经验共享范围内的友军形成一层保护屏障。该屏障在首次创建后的 4 秒内会保持无敌状态，在此期间受到的伤害将被添加到它的基础生命值 |HEALTH| 中。

descriptions.en: Second Ability launches an energy bomb that explodes with a |RADIUS|m radius, stripping |PERCENT|% of enemy armor. Tap <ACTIVATE_ABILITY_1> again to detonate in-flight.
descriptions.zh: 第二技能发射一枚爆炸半径 |RADIUS| 米的能量爆弹，削减敌人 |PERCENT|% 护甲。再次使用 <ACTIVATE_ABILITY_1> 可在爆弹飞行过程中引爆。

descriptions.en: Warframe punches the ground, dealing high damage to enemies in a small radius.
descriptions.zh: 战甲震击地面，在小范围内对敌人造成大量伤害。

descriptions.en: Slash and dash through enemies alongside a radial specter. The powerful Exalted Blade’s slashes inflict <DT_SLASH_COLOR>Slash Status.
descriptions.zh: 随着残影对敌人进行冲刺斩击。强大的显赫刀剑斩击造成 <DT_SLASH_COLOR>切割异常状态。

descriptions.en: Excalibur launches into the air, jumping 3x higher than normal.
descriptions.zh: 圣剑向上弹射到空中，其跳跃高度是一般跳跃的三倍。

descriptions.en: Loki camouflages himself, becoming invisible to enemies.
descriptions.zh: 邪神洛基伪装自身，让自己在敌人面前隐形。

descriptions.en: Blast nearby foes with a burst of fire, and follow that up with a barrage of fireballs against any enemy who dares approach. Over time, these fireballs burn hotter as they consume more energy.
descriptions.zh: 用猛火爆发燃烧附近的敌人，并随之用一连串的火球打击胆敢靠近的敌人。随着时间的推移，火球将燃烧得更猛烈，也消耗更多能量。

descriptions.en: Blast nearby foes with a burst of fire, and follow that up with a barrage of fireballs against any enemy who dares approach. Over time, these fireballs burn hotter as they consume more energy.
descriptions.zh: 用猛火爆发燃烧附近的敌人，并随之用一连串的火球打击胆敢靠近的敌人。随着时间的推移，火球将燃烧得更猛烈，也消耗更多能量。

descriptions.en: Cast a wave of energy that chains them where they stand. Each enemy held reinforces Harrow's shields.
descriptions.zh: 释放一道能量波动将敌人锁在原地。每一个被锁住的敌人都将强化驱魔使者的护盾。

descriptions.en: Protect nearby allies with an energy force that absorbs all damage and converts it to a Critical Chance bonus for all those under the Covenant. Headshots are amplified even further.
descriptions.zh: 以能量保护附近的友军，对处于「庇佑圣约」保护下的所有人，可吸收一切伤害并将之转化为暴击几率的加成。击中头部时暴击几率将被进一步增幅。

descriptions.en: Sacrifice Shields to boost Reload Speed, and Fire Rate while converting damage inflicted on enemies into health for Harrow and nearby allies.
descriptions.zh: 牺牲一定护盾来提升装填和射击速度，同时将施加于敌人的伤害转化为驱魔使者和附近友军的生命。

descriptions.en: Channel Harrow's energy into the Thurible to generate a buff. Once finished, kill enemies to bestow nearby allies with bursts of energy. The more energy channeled the greater the reward for each kill. Headshots produce extra energy.
descriptions.zh: 将驱魔使者的能量导引至「聚能焚炉」以产生增幅效果。一旦导引完成，消灭敌人就会给予附近友军能量喷发。导引使用的能量越多，每个消灭获得的返还奖励就越高。爆头可产生额外能量。

descriptions.en: Summon a mighty bow and unleash a volley of devastating arrows.
descriptions.zh: 召唤出一把强力长弓并发动毁灭性的集中箭矢射击。

descriptions.en: Assume control of any projectile launched by Ivara and guide it to the target.
descriptions.zh: 操控神弓游侠所发射出的投射物并引导飞向目标处。

descriptions.en: Cycle through and shoot one of four tactical arrows. Cloak creates a stationary bubble that cloaks Ivara and allies. Dashwire creates a traversable zipline. Noise emits a high-pitched sound that attracts enemies to it. Sleep temporarily puts nearby enemies into a deep slumber.
descriptions.zh: 循环切换并射击出四种战术箭矢之一。隐蔽会创造一个使神弓游侠和队友隐形的固定球体。悬丝则可形成一道滑索。喧扰会发出高频声波并吸引敌人。沉睡之箭能使附近的敌人陷入沉睡。

descriptions.en: Become invisible and steal loot from unsuspecting enemies or take out prey with deadly headshots.
descriptions.zh: 进入隐身状态并从毫无警觉的敌人身上偷取道具，或以致命的击中头部射击取走猎物的性命。

descriptions.en: Dash through enemies as a wall of sentient energy, leeching shields and health from any encountered, enhanced for thralls.
descriptions.zh: 化为一堵由灵煞能量组成的墙壁穿过敌人，吸取所接触敌人的护盾和生命，来自奴仆的效果受到增幅。

descriptions.en: Convert a target into a zealous thrall. Thralls turn on their allies and enthrall through damage. On death, they disintegrate into a damaging pillar of energy. The thrall horde remains under Revenants spell until this ability runs out.
descriptions.zh: 将目标转化为一个狂热的奴仆。奴仆会攻击他们的友军，并通过伤害奴役更多目标。当目标阵亡后，将会分解为可以产生伤害的能量柱。成群的奴仆将持续受到徘徊夜灵控制，直到此技能结束。

descriptions.en: Erupt with a multitude of Eidolon energy beams and sweep a circle of death around Revenant. The beams will modify their Damage Type to target select defenses, while incoming damage is redirected back into the beams. Hold fire to boost Status Effects and Damage, at the cost of increased energy consumption. Thralls killed by this ability leave overshield pickups.
descriptions.zh: 喷发出数条夜灵能量光束，形成一个死亡之环扫荡徘徊夜灵的四周。光束会根据所选的防御调整伤害类型，而徘徊夜灵遭受的伤害将转化为光束伤害。按住射击键可以额外能量为代价强化异常状态和伤害。被此技能杀死的奴仆将掉落过载护盾可拾取物。

descriptions.en: Become enveloped in Sentient energy, redirecting damage and stunning all those who dare attack. Stunned enemies can be Enthralled at no energy cost.
descriptions.zh: 受到灵煞能量包围，偏转伤害并震晕胆敢攻击者。奴役被震晕的敌人不消耗能量。

descriptions.en: Rhino hardens his skin, insulating himself from all damage and gaining Overguard.
descriptions.zh: 狂野犀牛硬化他的皮肤，隔绝一切伤害并获得超宏防护。

descriptions.en: Rhino charges towards a target, clobbering any in his path and goring his victim.
descriptions.zh: 狂野犀牛向目标冲锋，击倒突进路径上的一切阻碍，并以犀角强烈顶击目标。

descriptions.en: Grants all nearby Warframes increased damage for a short duration.
descriptions.zh: 短时间内让所有附近的战甲提升伤害输出。

descriptions.en: Rhino stomps with force sufficient to disrupt time, tumbling enemies around him in stasis.
descriptions.zh: 狂野犀牛的强力践踏可以扰乱时间秩序，将周围的敌人锁定在时间中。

descriptions.en: Generate armor plating that converts a portion of absorbed Kinetic Damage (Physical, <DT_FIRE_COLOR>Heat, <DT_FREEZE_COLOR>Cold, and <DT_EXPLOSION_COLOR>Blast) into Energy. Also protects Gauss from being staggered or knocked down. Damage Resistance is relative to the battery level.
descriptions.zh: 产生可以将一部份所吸收的动能伤害（物理、<DT_FIRE_COLOR>火焰、<DT_FREEZE_COLOR>冰冻，以及　<DT_EXPLOSION_COLOR>爆炸）转成能量的动能镀层。同时也保护迅电驰影免于失去平衡或是被击倒。伤害抗性与电池电量是相对的。

descriptions.en: Push Gauss' battery beyond the redline, supercharging his Abilities and setting Fire Rate, Attack Speed, Reload Speed, and Casting Speed into overdrive. When past the redline, bolts of arcing electricity dance periodically from Gauss, exploding en masse when the ability is deactivated.
descriptions.zh: 将迅电驰影的电池过载至超出安全上限，大幅增强他的技能并将射速、攻击速度、装填速度，以及施放速度都设置为超载状态。当超出安全上限时，电弧束会周期性地在迅电驰影身上跃动，并在技能停用时爆炸。

descriptions.en: Burst into a hyper-sprint bowling over enemies and charging the battery. Crashing into solid objects generates a powerful shockwave. Hold to rush continuously.
descriptions.zh: 猛冲产生一个超级冲刺来撞倒敌人并对电池蓄电，或是撞上坚固的物体来产生强大的震荡波。长按按键以持续冲刺。

descriptions.en: Siphon kinetic energy from the area, charging the battery and inflicting <DT_FREEZE_COLOR>Cold Status on nearby enemies. Hold reverses the process, draining the battery and inflicting <DT_FIRE_COLOR>Heat Status on nearby enemies.
descriptions.zh: 从附近区域吸取动能，为电池蓄电并为附近的敌人带来<DT_FREEZE_COLOR>冰冻状态。长按按键来逆转这一过程，通过消耗电池来使附近的敌人处于<DT_FIRE_COLOR>火焰伤害的状态中。

descriptions.en: Activate to form Armor by draining Inaros' Health. Activate again to stop the formation early. The protective layer reduces incoming Damage and absorbs Status Effects.
descriptions.zh: 将沙海怒涛的生命值来转化为护甲。再次使用可以提前终止护甲的转化。保护层减少受到的伤害并使沙海怒涛免疫异常状态。

descriptions.en: Blast enemies with a wave of cursed sand that blinds them and steals their health.
descriptions.zh: 使用一波带有诅咒的沙尘卷向敌人，致盲的同时窃取对方的生命。

descriptions.en: Become a sandstorm. Inaros devours enemies pulled into his whirlwind, healing himself.
descriptions.zh: 化身为沙尘暴。沙海怒涛吞噬被卷入沙暴中的敌人，并治愈自己。

descriptions.en: Summon a Scarab Swarm to attack enemies with guaranteed <DT_CORROSIVE_COLOR>Corrosive Status. Damage scales with Inaros' Health. Enemies killed while immersed in the swarm summon a Swarm Kavat that fights alongside Inaros and guides the scarabs to other enemies.
descriptions.zh: 召唤带有 <DT_CORROSIVE_COLOR>腐蚀触发效果的圣甲虫群来攻击敌人。伤害与沙海怒涛的生命值成正比。被虫群淹没的敌人死亡后会召唤一个沙土库娃，与沙海怒涛并肩作战，并引导圣甲虫找到其他敌人。

descriptions.en: Release a poisonous miasma that deals <DT_VIRAL_COLOR>Viral Damage to enemies in range. Foes afflicted by spores are more susceptible to the mist.
descriptions.zh: 释放剧毒的瘴气，对范围内的敌人造成<DT_VIRAL_COLOR>病毒伤害。受到孢子影响的敌人会遭到毒雾更深的感染。

descriptions.en: Inflict a target with a pox of <DT_CORROSIVE_COLOR>Corrosive spores. Spread spores to nearby enemies by destroying them or killing their host. The longer the Spore spreads, its damage will increase.
descriptions.zh: 使目标受到<DT_CORROSIVE_COLOR>腐蚀孢子的感染。破坏孢子或消灭宿主可以将孢子扩散到附近的敌人。孢子扩散的时间越久，伤害就越高。

descriptions.en: Shedding her skin like a snake, Saryn leaves a decoy behind to draw fire from enemies.
descriptions.zh: 剧毒之触脱落如蛇般的皮肤，在身后留下诱饵吸引敌人的火力。

descriptions.en: While active, attacks deal additional <DT_POISON_COLOR>Toxin Damage; this effect is doubled for Melee Strikes. Instantly burst spores when attacking afflicted enemies.
descriptions.zh: 激活时，攻击将造成额外的 <DT_POISON_COLOR>毒素伤害；该效果对近战攻击有双倍加成。攻击被孢子感染的敌人将立刻引爆孢子。

descriptions.en: Shedding her skin like a snake, Saryn leaves a decoy behind to draw fire from enemies.
descriptions.zh: 剧毒之触脱落如蛇般的皮肤，在身后留下诱饵吸引敌人的火力。

descriptions.en: Converge three streams of raw energy upon a single point, causing a massive explosion. The streams strip armor and shields, and each enemy struck detonates on stream convergence. Summoned Conculysts can wield their own mini Fusion Strikes.
descriptions.zh: 将三股原始能量流汇聚至一个点上，引发巨大爆炸。这些能量流能剥离敌人的护甲和护盾，每个被击中的敌人都会在能量流汇聚时被引爆。召唤的震荡使可施放自己的迷你版融合打击。

descriptions.en: Smash the ground sending out a radial wave of destruction. Those not killed by the initial blast are helplessly raised into the air, where they take amplified damage for a short time.
descriptions.zh: 猛击地面发射毁灭般的脉冲波。没有被最初的爆炸消灭的敌人会被无助地升至空中，在短时间内受到更高的伤害。

descriptions.en: Cycle through Sentient unit types, then summon them to Caliban's side. Conculysts focus on raw melee damage. Ortholysts specialize in ranged attacks and inflict <DT_SENTIENT_COLOR>Tau Status Effect. Summulysts summon their own Choralysts and provide shield protection for the squad.
descriptions.zh: 在灵煞单位类型之间切换，然后将其召唤到卡利班的身旁。震荡使专注于原始近战伤害。直垂使擅长远程攻击并且能造成 <DT_SENTIENT_COLOR>陶异常状态。召唤使能召唤自己的唱鸣使，并为小队提供护盾保护。

descriptions.en: Dash forward in a spinning vortex of death. Struck enemies are inflicted with <DT_SENTIENT_COLOR>Tau Status Effect, making them more vulnerable to all other status effects. For each enemy hit, recover a portion of the energy cost, as well as health and shields. Enemies lifted by Sentient Wrath take increased damage.
descriptions.zh: 在旋转的死亡漩涡中向前冲刺。被击中的敌人会受到 <DT_SENTIENT_COLOR>陶异常状态的影响，使其更易受到其他所有异常状态的伤害。每击中一个敌人，可恢复一部分能量消耗，以及生命值和护盾。被灵煞之怒举起的敌人受到额外伤害。

descriptions.en: Release a fiery projectile that ignites enemies on contact.
descriptions.zh: 释放一个燃烧的投射物，点燃接触到的目标。

descriptions.en:
Envelop Orion in an Astral Shell. Upon taking damage the shell becomes a decoy that draws fire until it's destroyed.

(HOLD) Swap to Sirius and use Jade Stars.
descriptions.zh:
将奥里昂包裹在星壳中。外壳受到伤害后会变成诱饵，吸引火力直至被摧毁。

（按住）切换到西里斯并使用翠玉之星。

descriptions.en:
Repel enemies with Orion's sinister scythe, dealing <DT_SLASH_COLOR>Slash Damage and Status Effect while reducing shields and armor.

(HOLD) Swap to Sirius and use Coronal Ejection.
descriptions.zh:
使用奥里昂的邪恶镰刀击退敌人，造成切割伤害和异常状态，同时削弱敌人的护盾和护甲。

（按住）切换到西里斯并使用日冕抛射。

descriptions.en:
Orion forms a drifting black hole, trapping enemies within its gravity. Hitting the black hole with Gravitic Slash or Coronal Ejection will extend its duration and change its trajectory: Gravitic Slash will direct it away from Orion, and Coronal Ejection will pull it towards Sirius.

(HOLD) Swap to Sirius and use Light's Sanctuary.
descriptions.zh:
奥里昂形成一个漂移的黑洞，将敌人困于其引力之中。以「重力斩」或「日冕抛射」命中黑洞可延长其持续时间，并改变其移动轨迹：「重力斩」会使其远离奥里昂，而「日冕抛射」会将其拉向西里斯。

（按住）切换至西里斯并使用「光之圣域」。

descriptions.en:
Sirius conjures Jade Light motes that slowly regenerate over time. Attacking enemies launches the motes, dealing <DT_FIRE_COLOR>Heat Damage and Status Effect.

(HOLD) Swap to Orion and use Astral Shell.
descriptions.zh:
西里斯召唤翠玉之光微粒，这些微粒会随时间缓慢再生。攻击敌人会发射这些微粒，造成火焰伤害和异常状态。

（按住）切换到奥里昂并使用星壳。

descriptions.en:
Sirius creates a well of light that heals and revives allies, while reducing incoming damage. The well slowly grows in size and power.

(HOLD) Swap to Orion and use Event Horizon.
descriptions.zh:
西里斯会创造一个光之井，治疗并复活友军，同时减少受到的伤害。光之井的体积和威力会缓慢增长。

（按住）切换到奥里昂并使用事件视界。

descriptions.en:
Sirius & Orion take to the skies in a cosmic duel. Each attack consumes a Constellation Star to inflict colossal collateral |DAMAGE_TYPE| damage. Match the star's color to the Warframes color to gain increased Critical Chance.

|LEFT_ATTACK| Sirius attacks
|RIGHT_ATTACK| Orion attacks

Generate Constellation Stars by using abilities. No more than two stars of the same color can be added in a row.
descriptions.zh:
西里斯&奥里昂在宇宙中展开决斗。每次攻击都会消耗一颗众星，造成巨大的附加 |DAMAGE_TYPE|伤害。将星星的颜色与战甲颜色匹配，可提高暴击几率。

|LEFT_ATTACK| 西里斯攻击
|RIGHT_ATTACK| 奥里昂攻击

使用技能以生成众星。同一颜色的星星最多只能连续生成两颗。

descriptions.en:
Hurl Sirius' Jade Light infused scythe, dealing <DT_FIRE_COLOR>Heat Damage while collecting any pickups in its path.

(HOLD) Swap to Orion and use Gravitic Slash.
descriptions.zh:
投掷西里斯的翠玉之光镰刀，造成火焰伤害，并拾取路径上的所有物品。

（按住）切换到奥里昂并使用重力斩。

descriptions.en: Absorb incoming damage and cast it back at enemies in a barrage of energy projectiles.
descriptions.zh: 吸收来袭的伤害，并释放一连串能量弹射回敌人身上。

descriptions.en: Cast a shadow that stuns enemies and obscures their vision, briefly making Stalker invisible.
descriptions.zh: 释放暗影眩晕敌人并阻碍其视线，并短暂地使追猎者隐形。

descriptions.en: Stun a target. When a target dies, a portion of damage dealt to the target is dealt to other nearby enemies.
descriptions.zh: 击晕目标。当目标阵亡后，其受到的一部分伤害将会转移到附近的其他敌人。

descriptions.en: Teleport to a target and perform a finisher. If the finisher kills the target, Stalker regains a portion of the energy spent.
descriptions.zh: 瞬移至目标并进行处决。如果处决消灭了目标，将为追猎者恢复一部分消耗的能量。

descriptions.en:
Once a charge has been built up on the Backbeat metronome, set Lizzie aflame and torch enemies with <DT_FIRE_COLOR>Heat. While aimed, Lizzie blasts enemies with thunderous elemental sound waves, use ability controls to change the Elemental Damage type.

Backbeat Timing: No Energy consumed.
descriptions.zh:
一旦反拍节拍器上积聚了能量，丽兹就会燃烧起来，用 <DT_FIRE_COLOR>火焰焚烧敌人。瞄准时，丽兹以轰鸣的元素声波轰击敌人，可通过技能按键发射不同元素类型的声波。

反拍节奏：本技能不消耗能量。

descriptions.en:
Blast targeted enemies with pillars of <DT_FIRE_COLOR>Heat Damage. 

Backbeat Timing: Ignite even more pillars. Increases the Duration and <DT_FIRE_COLOR>Heat Damage of Ripper's Wail when it deals damage.
descriptions.zh:
用 <DT_FIRE_COLOR>火焰伤害火柱冲击目标敌人。 

反拍节奏：生成更多火柱。该技能造成伤害时，增加撕裂者之嚎的持续时间和 <DT_FIRE_COLOR>火焰伤害。

descriptions.en:
Rip on the guitar to make Temple briefly invulnerable while healing them. Ally’s weapons in <AFFINITY_SHARE>Affinity Range are lit-up with extra <DT_FIRE_COLOR>Heat Damage each time an ability is used on the Backbeat and successfully hits enemies.

Backbeat Timing: Invulnerability lasts longer.
descriptions.zh:
弹奏吉他，使赤焰狂歌获得短暂无敌并同时获得治疗。每当随着反拍的节奏使用技能时并成功命中敌人时，<AFFINITY_SHARE>经验共享范围内的友军武器都会被点亮并获得额外的 <DT_FIRE_COLOR>火焰伤害加成。

反拍节奏：无敌状态持续时间更长。

descriptions.en:
Drive loudspeakers into epic distortion to create a damaging wave of <DT_FIRE_COLOR>Heat Damage while also increasing vulnerability to Critical Chance. 

Backbeat Timing: Doubles Critical Chance. Increases the Duration and <DT_FIRE_COLOR>Heat Damage of Ripper’s Wail when it deals damage.
descriptions.zh:
通过将扬声器推向极度失真来产生一波具有破坏力且带有 <DT_FIRE_COLOR>火焰伤害的热浪，同时使敌人更容易受到暴击。

反拍节奏：暴击几率翻倍。该技能造成伤害时，增加撕裂者之嚎的持续时间和 <DT_FIRE_COLOR>火焰伤害。

descriptions.en: Hold while airborne to hover Zephyr with reduced movement. From the air, tap to dash forward, or aim down to dive bomb enemies below.
descriptions.zh: 在空中按住技能键，来使狂啸西风悬停并减慢移动速度。在空中时，轻按技能键来向前冲刺，或是瞄准地面对下方的敌人使出俯冲轰击。

descriptions.en: Launch a burst of massively dense air. Hold to send enemies flying, tap to pull them toward the burst. Damage increases per enemy hit.
descriptions.zh: 发射一团高密度爆发空气。长按把敌人击飞，轻按则把他们拉向爆炸中央。每击中一个敌人，造成的伤害就会增加。

descriptions.en: Create deadly tornadoes that seek out and engulf enemies. Tornadoes deal the elemental Damage Type they absorb the most. Shoot engulfed enemies to inflict extra damage. Hold for stationary tornadoes or tap for wandering ones.
descriptions.zh: 制造致命的「龙卷云风」，四处搜寻并吞没敌人。「龙卷云风」会造成它们所吸收最多的元素伤害类型。射击被吞没的敌人来造成额外伤害。长按制造固定不动的「龙卷云风」，轻按则制造游走的「龙卷云风」。

descriptions.en: Creates a wind shield around Zephyr, redirecting all incoming projectiles.
descriptions.zh: 围绕狂啸西风生成一个风护盾，把所有射进来的子弹都偏转到其他方向。

descriptions.en:
Erect a containment field to capture enemies and suspend them in stasis, stripping their armor and granting it to Vauban and any allies within Bastille's field.

HOLD to collapse all Bastilles into a single damaging vortex.
descriptions.zh: 建立一个包围力场以捕获敌人使他们陷入停滞状态，剥离其护甲并将其转移给工程统帅和「力场牢狱」范围内的所有友军。 长按技能键来使所有力场牢狱坍塌成为一个破坏性旋涡。

descriptions.en:
Control the battlefield with masterful mines. Vauban's Tether-Flechette orb immobilizes and draws in enemies while launching deadly nails in all directions.

HOLD to launch a Vector-Overdrive pad that accelerates foes and allies alike in the pad's direction, increasing ally Movement Speed and Weapon Damage.
descriptions.zh:
用精妙的地雷掌控战场。工程统帅的桎梏飞掷丸能束缚并吸引敌人，同时向四面八方发射致命的飞镖。

按住即可发射矢量超载垫，为垫子方向上的敌我双方加速，并提升友军的移动速度和武器伤害。

descriptions.en: Drop a targeting beacon that calls in a devastating laser artillery strike. Deals doubled damage to enemies with Overguard.
descriptions.zh: 投下一个定位信标，来召唤一场毁灭性的激光火炮打击。对拥有超宏防护的敌人造成双倍伤害。

descriptions.en: Deploy a roller drone that attaches itself to enemies and delivers bursts of arcing <DT_ELECTRICITY_COLOR> Electricity Damage to anything in the immediate area.
descriptions.zh: 部署一架可以将自身附着在敌人身上的滚子无人机，并向附近区域的任何物体发出炸裂电弧，造成 <DT_ELECTRICITY_COLOR>电击伤害。

descriptions.en: Restore the health and shields of allies within <AFFINITY_SHARE>Affinity Range while reducing the damage they take from enemies.
descriptions.zh: 恢复 <AFFINITY_SHARE>经验共享范围内友军的生命值和护盾，同时减少他们受到的敌人伤害。

descriptions.en: Allies will gain energy over time when enemies are marked with Energy Vampire.
descriptions.zh: 友军将在伤害被能力吸取标记的敌人同时获得能量。

descriptions.en: Any damage taken while Link is active will be channeled to a nearby enemy.
descriptions.zh: 链接激活时，一切受到的伤害将转移给身边的一个敌人。

descriptions.en: Create a well of life on an enemy who will absorb Status Effect damage intended for nearby allies. Allies gain additional Health when they attack the target. If allies die, enemies in the well of life die in their stead.
descriptions.zh: 在敌人身上创造一道生命之井，吸收附近队友受到的异常状态伤害。队友攻击目标时可获得额外生命值。如果队友死亡，生命之井中的敌人将代替他们死亡。

descriptions.en: Volt discharges the electricity that courses through him. The shockwave paralyzes and damages nearby enemies. Enemies on the edge of the shockwave are stunned.
descriptions.zh: 伏特会释放流淌全身的电流。冲击波会麻痹并伤害附近的敌人。处在冲击波边缘的敌人则会被击晕。

descriptions.en:
Volt deploys an electric shield that blocks enemy fire and adds <DT_ELECTRICITY_COLOR>Electricity Damage to projectiles.
 
HOLD to equip the shield for mobile cover.
descriptions.zh:
伏特部署一个电力屏障，能阻挡敌方火力，并对投射物附加<DT_ELECTRICITY_COLOR>电击伤害。

长按可装备屏障，作为移动掩护。

descriptions.en: Launch a voltaic projectile that stuns and damages its target. A chain of electricity extends from the target to shock nearby enemies.
descriptions.zh: 发射一个能击晕并伤害目标的伏电射弹。一串电弧以目标为中心，散发式电击附近的敌人。

descriptions.en: Embody an electric current. Volt and his allies receive a brief movement speed boost and a reload speed buff.
descriptions.zh: 显现一支电流。伏特与其队友会获得短暂的移动速度和装填速度增益。

descriptions.en:
(TAP) Raksh's fangs tear into your enemies. 5 random Status Effects are applied at 10 Stacks each on an enemy. On target's death, spread the Status Effects to other nearby enemies.

(HOLD) Raksh guards Voruna with Status Effect resistance.
descriptions.zh:
（轻按）亚克什的尖牙会撕裂你的敌人。5 个随机异常状态会在敌人身上堆叠 10 层。当目标阵亡时，其身上的异常状态会传播给附近的其他敌人。

（长按）亚克什会守护赤影狼母，提升她的异常状态抗性。

descriptions.en:
(TAP) Voruna drops to all fours and prepares 5 brutal charges that lock onto enemies. Ulfrun, the most powerful wolf, leads the attack as Voruna dashes toward her target. The pack deals increased damage to targets and nearby enemies that are inflicted by Status Effects. Lethal attacks double the damage of Voruna's remaining charges.

(HOLD) Ulfrun guards Voruna. If Voruna falls during this time, Ulfrun dies in her place.
descriptions.zh:
（轻按）赤影狼母四肢着地并有 5 次凶残地冲向锁定敌人的机会。在赤影狼母冲向目标时，最强之狼乌尔佛伦会率先发起攻击。狼群们对受到异常状态影响的目标及其周围的敌人造成更高的伤害。致命攻击将使赤影狼母剩余冲锋所造成的伤害翻倍。

（长按）乌尔佛伦守护赤影狼母。如果赤影狼母在守护期间死亡，则乌尔佛伦会代替她死去。

descriptions.en:
(TAP) Lycath hunts to sustain the pack. Enemies killed by melee attacks drop health orbs and enemies killed by headshots drop energy orbs. Increase the duration of Lycath’s hunt by killing enemies affected by 5 or more Status Effects.

(HOLD) Lycath guards Voruna with increased Heavy Attack efficiency.
descriptions.zh:
（轻按）莱卡斯狩猎以维系狼群。被近战消灭的敌人会掉落生命球，被击中头部消灭的敌人则会掉落能量球。消灭受 5 个或更多异常状态影响的敌人来延长「莱卡斯之猎」的时间。

（长按）莱卡斯会守护赤影狼母，提升她的重击效率。

descriptions.en:
(TAP) Dynar shrouds Voruna with invisibility and accelerates her speed. Invisibility ends when Voruna attacks. For a short time after invisibility ends, melee attacks have increased Critical Damage, Status Chance, Critical Chance and inflict <DT_SLASH_COLOR>Slash Status Effects. Melee kill an enemy during this time to extend the melee buff once per cast.

(HOLD) Dynar guards Voruna, increasing her Parkour Velocity.
descriptions.zh:
（轻按）戴拿会使赤影狼母隐身并提高她的移动速度。赤影狼母攻击时会结束隐身状态。在隐身状态结束后的短时间内，提升近战攻击的暴击伤害、触发几率、暴击几率并造成 <DT_SLASH_COLOR>切割异常状态。如果在增益期间近战消灭敌人，这些限时近战增益在每次施放技能时则会延长一次。 

（长按）戴拿会守护赤影狼母，提升她的跑酷速度。

descriptions.en:
Open a dimensional breach to overwhelm nearby enemies and cause them to release aggressive Surge sparks when damaged.
Wisp may also target a Reservoir to teleport to it and double the range of the surge.
descriptions.zh:
打开一个维度缺口来压倒附近的敌人，并使他们在受到伤害时释放出侵略性的电涌火花。
离火幻灵亦可瞄准一个储能池传送，并倍化涌流的范围。

descriptions.en: Cast forward a spectral image of Wisp to confuse and distract enemies. Reactivate to travel to its position. Hold to have the image travel faster and teleport to its position on release.
descriptions.zh: 投射一个离火幻灵的光谱图像来迷惑和分散敌人的注意力。重新启动图像来移动到它所在的位置。按住按键来使图像移动速度更快，并在释放按键时传送到它所在的位置。

descriptions.en: Choose and summon a Reservoir filled with Motes that attach to and aid Wisp and her allies. Haste Mote grants increased movement and attack speed. Vitality Mote increases maximum health and heals over time. Shock Mote stuns nearby enemies.
descriptions.zh: 选择并召唤一个充满尘埃的储能池来帮助离火幻灵和她的友军。急速尘埃可以增加移动和攻击速度。活力尘埃可以增加最大生命值和治疗时间。震荡尘埃可以震晕附近的敌人。

descriptions.en: Open a portal to the sun to irradiate enemies with a devastating beam of pure solar plasma. Hold fire to double Damage at the cost of increased energy consumption. For the duration of an attack enemies damaged by Sol Gate are increasingly more vulnerable to it.
descriptions.zh: 打开一扇通往太阳的传送门，放出毁灭性的纯阳等离子光束。按住射击键会使伤害加倍，但同时也会增加能量消耗。当太阳之门持续攻击敌人时，会对敌人造成更多伤害。

descriptions.en: Ghostly hands pull enemies into a flailing mass.
descriptions.zh: 通过幽灵之手把敌人聚成一堆。

descriptions.en: Dash through enemies and rip out their souls to heal Shadow.
descriptions.zh: 冲刺穿过敌人并撕裂他们的灵魂来治疗幽影。

descriptions.en: Inflict nearby enemies with a harrowing condition.
descriptions.zh: 使周围的敌人痛苦不堪。

descriptions.en: Sevagoth and his Shadow become one.
descriptions.zh: 虚冥鬼影和他的幽影合为一体。

descriptions.en: Summon a radial pulse wave that ensnares and slows enemies, siphoning their lifeforce for the Death Well. Allies within the wave steal health with each attack.
descriptions.zh: 召唤一道放射脉冲波，来诱捕敌人落入技能范围并使其减速，同时吸取他们的生命力并注入「死亡之井」。处在脉冲波范围内的友军每次攻击都会吸取敌人的生命值。

descriptions.en: Sevagoth's Shadow flies outward ravaging enemies in his path. Survivors are damaged by Death’s Harvest over time. The souls of the dead fill the Death Well.
descriptions.zh: 虚冥鬼影的幽影向外飞去来蹂躏路径上的敌人。幸存者会随时间流逝，受到来自「死亡收割」的伤害。亡魂将会注入「死亡之井」。

descriptions.en: When the Death Well fills, Sevagoth's Shadow form is ready to be released. Tear the enemy asunder with a collection of melee-focused abilities.
descriptions.zh: 当「死亡之井」被注满时，将能够释放虚冥鬼影的幽影形态；并可使用一系列近战技能撕裂敌人。

descriptions.en: Plant a death seed in nearby targets to drain their lifeforce. Reap what has been sown to detonate afflicted enemies, dealing a percentage of their health as radial damage. The souls of the dead fill the Death Well.
descriptions.zh: 向附近的目标种下死亡之种来汲取他们的生命力。收割已播种的死亡之种来引爆受影响的敌人，并按照他们生命值的百分比来造成范围伤害。亡魂将会注入「死亡之井」。

descriptions.en: Summon Merulina, a rideable creature of the waves, and the inspiration for K-Driving. Merulina protects Yareli by absorbing a large portion of incoming damage.
descriptions.zh: 召唤浪漪珊瑚，这是一种浪涌中的可骑乘生物，也是 K 式悬浮板的灵感来源。浪漪珊瑚通过吸收大部分来袭的伤害从而保护咏浪之灵。

descriptions.en:
Form five water globules that seek out enemies and expand on contact, simultaneously damaging and immobilizing their victims.
Enemies hit by the globules take increased damage from all sources.
descriptions.zh:
生成五个主动寻找敌人并会在触碰时膨胀的水球，同时对受害者造成伤害并使他们无法移动。
被水球击中的敌人受到所有来源的伤害都会增加。

descriptions.en: Tear through foes with a trio of orbiting aquatic blades.
descriptions.zh: 通过一把三刃环绕的水形之刃来撕裂敌人。

descriptions.en: Drag enemies into a crushing maelstrom and then blow them away in a watery burst. Each enemy trapped in the vortex increases the burst's damage.
descriptions.zh: 把敌人拖入一个毁灭性的漩涡中，然后用一股爆裂水压将他们炸飞。每个被困在漩涡中的敌人都会增加爆裂造成的伤害。

descriptions.en: In Night-Form, reduces damage inflicted by nearby enemies. In Day-Form, increases Ability Strength of nearby allies.
descriptions.zh: 〈黑夜形态〉时降低周围敌人造成的伤害。〈白昼形态〉时则增加附近友军的技能强度。

descriptions.en: In Night-Form, allies' Shields are replenished with each nearby enemy killed. In Day-Form, enemies are inflicted with <DT_SLASH_COLOR>Slash Status Effect. Deactivate while in Night-Form to restore Health and Shields for Equinox and allies. Deactivate while in Day-Form to cast a wave of slashing force.
descriptions.zh: 〈黑夜型态〉在附近被消灭的每一名敌人都能使友军恢复护盾。〈白昼型态〉使附近敌人陷入 <DT_SLASH_COLOR>切割异常状态，在〈黑夜型态〉时停用技能来为阴阳双子及友军恢复生命及护盾。在〈白昼型态〉时停用技能来释放出一波切割之力。

descriptions.en: Switch forms, temporarily gaining bonus Shields and Armor in Night-Form, or bonus Damage and Speed in Day-Form.
descriptions.zh: 昼夜交替：〈黑夜形态〉暂时获得额外护盾和护甲；〈白昼形态〉暂时获得额外伤害和速度。

descriptions.en: In Night-Form, targets are put to sleep. In Day-Form, targets become more vulnerable to damage.
descriptions.zh: 〈黑夜形态〉使目标敌人陷入沉睡；〈白昼形态〉对目标敌人造成更多伤害。

descriptions.zh: 致残

descriptions.en: Mend
descriptions.zh: 补愈

descriptions.zh: 狂野犀牛向目标冲锋，击倒突进路径上的一切阻碍，并以犀角强烈顶击目标。

descriptions.en: Charges forward, knocking down anything in the way.
descriptions.zh: 勇往直前，并扫荡掉路上遇到的一切阻碍。

descriptions.zh: 将定海神针恢复为原本的尺寸，打翻攻击路径上的所有敌人。

descriptions.en: Drops a smoke bomb that stuns enemies and obscures their vision, rendering Ash invisible for a short time.
descriptions.zh: 扔出烟雾弹眩晕敌人并阻碍其视线，同时灰烬之刃进入短暂的隐身状态。

descriptions.en: Summon a mighty bow and unleash a volley of devastating arrows.
descriptions.zh: 召唤出一把强力长弓并发动毁灭性的集中箭矢射击。

descriptions.en: Frost deep freezes any vapor and moisture in the area, creating a protective sphere with brief invulnerability to boost its strength.
descriptions.zh: 冻结周围所有水气与水分，制造出能用来防御的球形冰罩；冰罩生成时有短暂的无敌时间，此时敌人对冰罩造成的伤害能强化冰罩的耐久度；在相同位置重复施放冰罩可强化其耐久度。

descriptions.zh: 在极度的专注之下，圣枪弥撒抽出监察者双枪，对敌人快速地连续射击。

descriptions.en:
Drops a Temporal Anchor which, after a short duration, Protea rewinds to trigger a temporal implosion. Implosion damage increases based on damage dealt between anchor drop and rewind. Everything lost or expended in that time is returned.
Dying while Anchor is active rewinds Protea to the anchor, saving her. Protea is knocked down and the anchor vanishes.
descriptions.zh:

descriptions.zh: 4 秒内每再使用一次该技能都会让能量消耗翻倍，最高可达到 8x。
